quote: The dissolved oxygen content is always maintained above 6.5 mg/L, the ammonia nitrogen concentration is less than 0.5 mg/kg, and the pH range is 7.0–7.8.
statement: 溶解氧含量始终保持在6.5 mg/L以上，氨氮浓度低于0.5 mg/kg，pH值范围为7.0–7.8。
text_zh: 溶解氧含量始终保持在6.5 mg/L以上，氨氮浓度低于0.5 mg/kg，pH值范围为7.0–7.8。
text_en: Dissolved oxygen content was consistently maintained above 6.5 mg/L, ammonia nitrogen concentration was below 0.5 mg/kg, and pH ranged from 7.0–7.8.

quote: The DEMs were screened for C. auratus following A. hydrophila infection and the results revealed the differential expression profiles of 1,165 DEMs associated with the gill immune response of C. auratus (Figure 4A).
statement: 在嗜水气单胞菌感染后筛选了鲤的miRNA差异表达分子，结果显示有1,165个与鲤鳃免疫反应相关的差异表达分子。
text_zh: 在嗜水气单胞菌感染后筛选了鲤的miRNA差异表达分子，结果显示有1,165个与鲤鳃免疫反应相关的差异表达分子。

quote: Prior to the bacterial infection, the fish were acclimatized at a temperature of approximately 25°C in freshwater tanks (45 L) for 2 weeks and fed commercial dried pellets (Tongwei Co., Ltd., Chengdu, China) twice daily.
statement: 在细菌感染前，鱼在约25°C的淡水缸中适应两周，并每天两次喂食商业干颗粒饲料。
text_zh: 在细菌感染前，鱼在约25°C的淡水缸中适应两周，并每天两次喂食商业干颗粒饲料。
text_en: Before bacterial infection, fish were acclimated for two weeks in freshwater tanks at about 25°C and fed commercial dry pellet feed twice daily.

quote: In the infection experiment, the fish were immersed in A. hydrophila culture with a final concentration of 1 × 10 8 cfu/ml and then quickly transferred into freshwater after immersion for 3 h, in accordance with a previous report by Wang et al. (27).
statement: 在感染实验中，鱼被浸泡在终浓度为1×10^8 cfu/ml的气单胞菌培养液中，浸泡3小时后迅速转移至淡水中，此方法依据Wang等人之前的报告。
text_zh: 在感染实验中，鱼被浸泡在终浓度为1×10^8 cfu/ml的气单胞菌培养液中，浸泡3小时后迅速转移至淡水中，此方法依据Wang等人之前的报告。
text_en: In infection experiments, fish were immersed in an Aeromonas culture with a final concentration of 1×10^8 cfu/ml for 3 hours and then rapidly transferred to freshwater; this method was based on previous reports by Wang et al.

quote: Nevertheless, the outbreak of bacterial diseases of C. auratus is has become a serious problem, causing economic losses
statement: 鲤鲫（C. auratus）细菌性疾病的爆发已成为一个严重问题，造成经济损失。
text_zh: 鲤鲫（C. auratus）细菌性疾病的爆发已成为一个严重问题，造成经济损失。
text_en: Outbreaks of bacterial diseases in carp and crucian carp (C. auratus) have become a serious problem, causing economic losses.

quote: Clinically diseased C. auratus infected with A. hydrophila exhibited hyperemia, hemorrhage, and inflammatory lesion of the mucosal tissues in the gills, skin, and intestine, as well as congestion of the visceral organs.
statement: 感染嗜水气单胞菌的临床患病鲤鱼表现出鳃、皮肤和肠道黏膜组织的充血、出血和炎症病变，以及内脏器官淤血。
text_zh: 感染嗜水气单胞菌的临床患病鲤鱼表现出鳃、皮肤和肠道黏膜组织的充血、出血和炎症病变，以及内脏器官淤血。
text_en: Clinically ill carp infected with A. hydrophila exhibited congestion, hemorrhage, and inflammatory lesions in the gill, skin, and intestinal mucosal tissues, as well as visceral organ congestion.

quote: With the development of intensive aquaculture in China, the outbreak of bacterial diseases of the crucian carp C. auratus has become a serious problem, causing economic losses
statement: 中国集约化水产养殖的发展导致鲫鱼细菌性疾病爆发成为严重问题，造成经济损失。
text_zh: 中国集约化水产养殖的发展导致鲫鱼细菌性疾病爆发成为严重问题，造成经济损失。
text_en: The development of intensive aquaculture in China has led to outbreaks of bacterial diseases in crucian carp becoming a serious problem, causing economic losses.

quote: Recently, the spotlight on miRNA biomarkers, target genes, and immune regulation has been of great significance for the prevention and treatment of diseases in teleost fish
statement: 近期对miRNA生物标志物、靶基因和免疫调节的关注对于硬骨鱼疾病的预防和治疗具有重要意义。
text_zh: 近期对miRNA生物标志物、靶基因和免疫调节的关注对于硬骨鱼疾病的预防和治疗具有重要意义。
text_en: Recent attention to miRNA biomarkers, target genes, and immune regulation is of great significance for the prevention and treatment of bony fish diseases.
intervention: miRNA biomarker and immune regulation research

quote: The differential expression of the selected 20 known DEMs, including miR-10, miR-21, miR-100, miR-145, miR-148, miR-192, and miR-27b-3p, was significantly detected after A. hydrophila infection, indicating that these miRNAs were involved in the gill immune response process.
statement: 嗜水气单胞菌感染后检测到20种已知差异表达miRNA的显著变化，表明这些miRNA参与了鳃部免疫反应过程。
text_zh: 嗜水气单胞菌感染后检测到20种已知差异表达miRNA的显著变化，表明这些miRNA参与了鳃部免疫反应过程。
text_en: Significant changes in 20 known differentially expressed miRNAs were detected after Aeromonas hydrophila infection, indicating that these miRNAs are involved in the immune response process of the gills.

quote: Figure 1 Histopathological changes and hemocyte phagocytosis of Carassius auratus infected with Aeromonas hydrophila .
statement: 图1展示了感染嗜水气单胞菌的鲫鱼的组织病理学变化和血细胞吞噬作用。
text_zh: 图1展示了感染嗜水气单胞菌的鲫鱼的组织病理学变化和血细胞吞噬作用。
text_en: Figure 1 shows histopathological changes and blood cell phagocytosis in crucian carp infected with Aeromonas hydrophila.
outcome: 组织病理变化与免疫反应

quote: (B) Exfoliation and necrosis of gill respiratory epithelial cells (black arrow) and extensive inflammatory cell infiltration (white arrow).
statement: 感染组鱼鳃呼吸上皮细胞出现脱落和坏死，并伴有广泛的炎症细胞浸润。
text_zh: 感染组鱼鳃呼吸上皮细胞出现脱落和坏死，并伴有广泛的炎症细胞浸润。
text_en: In the infected group, sloughing and necrosis of gill respiratory epithelial cells occurred, accompanied by extensive inflammatory cell infiltration.

quote: (C) Intestinal villus atrophy, dehydration, vacuolization, and necrosis (white arrow), and lamina propria submucosa hemorrhage (black arrow).
statement: 感染组肠道绒毛出现萎缩、脱水、空泡化和坏死，固有层黏膜下层出血。
text_zh: 感染组肠道绒毛出现萎缩、脱水、空泡化和坏死，固有层黏膜下层出血。
text_en: In the infected group, intestinal villi showed atrophy, dehydration, vacuolization, and necrosis, with hemorrhage in the lamina propria and submucosa.

quote: Furthermore, TNF-α and PI3K showed an upward trend within 72 hpi.
statement: 此外，TNF-α和PI3K在感染后72小时内呈上升趋势。
text_zh: 此外，TNF-α和PI3K在感染后72小时内呈上升趋势。
text_en: In addition, TNF-α and PI3K showed an upward trend within 72 hours after infection.

quote: Compared with the gills of control fish, histopathological examination of the infected fish revealed high inflammatory cell infiltration in the base of the secondary gill lamellae, and the respiratory epithelial cells of the secondary lamellae showed hyperplasia, sloughing, and necrosis (Figures 1A, B).
statement: 与对照鱼相比，组织病理学检查显示感染鱼的次级鳃小叶基部有大量炎性细胞浸润，且次级小叶的呼吸上皮细胞出现增生、脱落和坏死。
text_zh: 与对照鱼相比，组织病理学检查显示感染鱼的次级鳃小叶基部有大量炎性细胞浸润，且次级小叶的呼吸上皮细胞出现增生、脱落和坏死。
text_en: Compared with control fish, histopathological examination showed massive inflammatory cell infiltration at the base of secondary lamellae in infected fish, and hyperplasia, detachment, and necrosis of respiratory epithelial cells in secondary lamellae.

quote: Severely damaged intestinal villi, atrophic change, and extensive vacuolization with hemorrhage in the intestinal mucosa were also detected (Figure 1C).
statement: 还检测到肠绒毛严重受损、萎缩性改变以及肠黏膜广泛空泡化伴出血。
text_zh: 还检测到肠绒毛严重受损、萎缩性改变以及肠黏膜广泛空泡化伴出血。
text_en: Severe damage to intestinal villi, atrophic changes, and widespread vacuolation of the intestinal mucosa with hemorrhage were also detected.

quote: In addition, the primary manifestations on the skin were hyperplasia of the epidermal mucus cells with hemorrhagic lesions, and different degrees of pathological changes such as hyperemia, hemorrhage, and inflammatory cell infiltration that occurred in the liver, kidney, and spleen.
statement: 此外，皮肤的主要表现是表皮粘液细胞增生伴出血性病变，肝脏、肾脏和脾脏也发生了不同程度的充血、出血和炎性细胞浸润等病理变化。
text_zh: 此外，皮肤的主要表现是表皮粘液细胞增生伴出血性病变，肝脏、肾脏和脾脏也发生了不同程度的充血、出血和炎性细胞浸润等病理变化。
text_en: In addition, the main skin manifestation was epidermal mucous cell hyperplasia accompanied by hemorrhagic lesions, and varying degrees of congestion, hemorrhage, and inflammatory cell infiltration occurred in the liver, kidney, and spleen.
outcome: 皮肤及内脏器官病理变化

quote: Extensive research on animals has highlighted the significant nutritional and physiological roles of betaine, including promoting growth, exerting antistress effects, improving reproductive performance, acting as an antioxidant, and providing osmotic protection [ 9 , 10 ]
statement: 大量动物研究表明，甜菜碱具有显著的营养和生理作用，包括促进生长、发挥抗应激作用、改善繁殖性能、作为抗氧化剂以及提供渗透保护。
text_zh: 大量动物研究表明，甜菜碱具有显著的营养和生理作用，包括促进生长、发挥抗应激作用、改善繁殖性能、作为抗氧化剂以及提供渗透保护。
text_en: Numerous animal studies have shown that betaine has significant nutritional and physiological effects, including promoting growth, exerting anti-stress effects, improving reproductive performance, acting as an antioxidant, and providing osmoprotection.
outcome: 综合福利指标（生长、应激、繁殖、抗氧化、渗透压）

quote: We previously observed that appropriate supplementation of betaine in a basic diet had a beneficial effect on alleviating lipid metabolism disorders induced by high-fat feeding, including a reduction in triglyceride (TG) levels in hepatopancreas
statement: 作者此前观察到，在基础日粮中适量补充甜菜碱有助于缓解由高脂喂养诱导的脂质代谢紊乱，包括降低肝胰腺中的甘油三酯水平。
text_zh: 作者此前观察到，在基础日粮中适量补充甜菜碱有助于缓解由高脂喂养诱导的脂质代谢紊乱，包括降低肝胰腺中的甘油三酯水平。
text_en: The authors previously observed that appropriate supplementation of betaine in a basic diet helps alleviate lipid metabolic disorders induced by high-fat feeding, including reducing triglyceride levels in the hepatopancreas.

quote: These findings suggest that betaine supplementation exerts its effects through the HNF4 α /MTTP/ApoB pathway, promoting the assembly and secretion of VLDL and effectively reducing lipid accumulation in the hepatopancreas of farmed gibel carp fed a high-fat diet.
statement: 甜菜碱补充剂通过HNF4α/MTTP/ApoB途径促进VLDL的组装和分泌，从而有效减少饲喂高脂饲料养殖鲫鱼的肝胰腺中脂质积累。
text_zh: 甜菜碱补充剂通过HNF4α/MTTP/ApoB途径促进VLDL的组装和分泌，从而有效减少饲喂高脂饲料养殖鲫鱼的肝胰腺中脂质积累。
text_en: Betaine supplementation promotes the assembly and secretion of VLDL via the HNF4α/MTTP/ApoB pathway, thereby effectively reducing lipid accumulation in the hepatopancreas of crucian carp fed a high-fat diet.

quote: several miRNAs (e.g., miR-21, miR-122, and miR-192-5p) were found to be differentially expressed in the Vibrio anguillarum -challenged M. miiuy (14 , 15).
statement: 在受鳗弧菌攻击的米氏黄花鱼中，发现几种miRNA（如miR-21、miR-122和miR-192-5p）差异表达。
text_zh: 在受鳗弧菌攻击的米氏黄花鱼中，发现几种miRNA（如miR-21、miR-122和miR-192-5p）差异表达。
text_en: In Sciaenops ocellatus challenged with Vibrio anguillarum, several miRNAs (such as miR-21, miR-122 and miR-192-5p) were found to be differentially expressed.
outcome: 疾病挑战下的基因表达

quote: It is well-established that prolonged consumption of high-fat diets can lead to metabolic disorders and adversely affect the growth and health of farmed fish [ 6 , 23 ].
statement: 长期食用高脂饲料会导致代谢紊乱，并对养殖鱼类的生长和健康产生不利影响。
text_zh: 长期食用高脂饲料会导致代谢紊乱，并对养殖鱼类的生长和健康产生不利影响。
text_en: Long-term consumption of high-fat feed leads to metabolic disorders and has adverse effects on the growth and health of farmed fish.

quote: In recent years, high-fat diets have become increasingly popular in intensive aquaculture as they offer increased energy, promoting protein sparing, and enhancing fish growth [ 2 – 4 ].
statement: 近年来，高脂饲料在集约化水产养殖中越来越受欢迎，因为它们提供更高的能量，促进蛋白质节省并增强鱼类生长。
text_zh: 近年来，高脂饲料在集约化水产养殖中越来越受欢迎，因为它们提供更高的能量，促进蛋白质节省并增强鱼类生长。
text_en: In recent years, high-fat diets have become increasingly popular in intensive aquaculture because they provide higher energy, promote protein sparing and enhance fish growth.

quote: One challenge is the increased susceptibility of high-fat diets to oxidation during storage, primarily due to their higher unsaturated fatty acid content. Oxidized oil can be toxic to fish, posing a risk to their health and well-being [ 5 ].
statement: 高脂饲料的一个挑战是其在储存过程中更容易氧化，这主要归因于其较高的不饱和脂肪酸含量。氧化油对鱼有毒，对其健康和福祉构成风险。
text_zh: 高脂饲料的一个挑战是其在储存过程中更容易氧化，这主要归因于其较高的不饱和脂肪酸含量。氧化油对鱼有毒，对其健康和福祉构成风险。
text_en: One challenge of high-fat feed is that it is more prone to oxidation during storage, which is mainly attributed to its higher content of unsaturated fatty acids. Oxidized oil is toxic to fish and poses a risk to their health and welfare.

quote: Another challenge associated with high-fat diets is the induction of hepatic steatosis, characterized by the excessive deposition of lipids in the liver [ 2 ].
statement: 与高脂饲料相关的另一个挑战是诱导脂肪肝，其特征是肝脏中脂质的过度沉积。
text_zh: 与高脂饲料相关的另一个挑战是诱导脂肪肝，其特征是肝脏中脂质的过度沉积。
text_en: Another challenge associated with high-fat diets is the induction of fatty liver, characterized by excessive lipid deposition in the liver.

quote: five isoprotein diets were formulated: a basal diet containing 5% lipid (referred to as the control group, CG), a high-fat diet containing 10% lipid (referred to as the high-fat group, HF), and three different levels of betaine supplementation in the high-fat diets (referred to as the high-fat betaine group, HFB): 1 g/kg (HFB1), 4 g/kg (HFB4), and 16 g/kg (HFB16), based on dry weight.
statement: 实验配制了五种等氮日粮，包括含5%脂质的基础日粮（对照组）、含10%脂质的高脂日粮（高脂组），以及在高脂日粮中添加不同水平甜菜碱的组别（1、4和16 g/kg）。
text_zh: 实验配制了五种等氮日粮，包括含5%脂质的基础日粮（对照组）、含10%脂质的高脂日粮（高脂组），以及在高脂日粮中添加不同水平甜菜碱的组别（1、4和16 g/kg）。
text_en: Five isonitrogenous diets were formulated, including a basal diet with 5% lipid (control group), a high-lipid diet with 10% lipid (high-lipid group), and groups with different levels of betaine added to the high-lipid diet (1, 4, and 16 g/kg).

quote: Gibel carp (initial weight of 1.65 ± 0.04 g) were randomly divided into 15 tanks (300 L, 35 fish per tank) and fed twice daily.
statement: 鲫鱼被随机分配到15个水箱中（每个水箱300升，35条鱼），每天喂食两次。
text_zh: 鲫鱼被随机分配到15个水箱中（每个水箱300升，35条鱼），每天喂食两次。
text_en: Crucian carp were randomly assigned to 15 tanks (300 liters per tank, 35 fish), and fed twice daily.

quote: The daily feeding amount was equivalent to 3%–4% of their body weight and was adjusted according to the weight of the fish.
statement: 每日投喂量相当于体重的3%-4%，并根据鱼的体重进行调整。
text_zh: 每日投喂量相当于体重的3%-4%，并根据鱼的体重进行调整。
text_en: The daily feeding amount is equivalent to 3%-4% of body weight and is adjusted according to the fish's body weight.

quote: After fast (24 hr) and anesthetization, the hepatopancreas of three fish from each tank were collected and fixed in 4% paraformaldehyde for histology and lipid deposition analysis.
statement: 经过24小时禁食和麻醉后，从每个水箱收集三条鱼的肝胰腺用于组织学和脂质沉积分析。
text_zh: 经过24小时禁食和麻醉后，从每个水箱收集三条鱼的肝胰腺用于组织学和脂质沉积分析。
text_en: After 24 hours of fasting and anesthesia, hepatopancreas from three fish per tank were collected for histological and lipid deposition analysis.

quote: A marked infiltration of lipids in the hepatocytes was also observed in the HF group.
statement: 在高脂组（HF）的肝细胞中观察到明显的脂质浸润。
text_zh: 在高脂组（HF）的肝细胞中观察到明显的脂质浸润。
text_en: Obvious lipid infiltration was observed in the hepatocytes of the high-fat group (HF).

quote: Larvae hatched after five days and were subsequently reared in a closed water system (150 L).
statement: 幼鱼在五天后孵化，随后在封闭水系统（150升）中饲养。
text_zh: 幼鱼在五天后孵化，随后在封闭水系统（150升）中饲养。
text_en: Larvae hatched after five days and were subsequently reared in a closed water system (150 liters).

quote: After seven months, juveniles were transferred to larger tanks in a flow-through system and raised to adulthood.
statement: 七个月后，幼鱼被转移到流水系统的更大水箱中并养至成年。
text_zh: 七个月后，幼鱼被转移到流水系统的更大水箱中并养至成年。
text_en: After seven months, the juveniles were transferred to larger tanks in a flow-through system and raised to adulthood.

quote: Our findings demonstrated that a 10-week period of high-fat feeding significantly increased TG levels in both the serum and hepatopancreas of gibel carp, consistent with similar studies conducted in other fish species [ 2 , 6 , 23 ].
statement: 本研究发现，为期10周的高脂喂养显著增加了银鲫血清和肝胰腺中的甘油三酯（TG）水平。
text_zh: 本研究发现，为期10周的高脂喂养显著增加了银鲫血清和肝胰腺中的甘油三酯（TG）水平。
text_en: This study found that a 10-week high-fat diet significantly increased triglyceride (TG) levels in the serum and hepatopancreas of gibel carp.

quote: Fish were held in 350 l aquaria in groups of 5-15 individuals depending on size.
statement: Fish were kept in 350-liter aquaria in groups of 5 to 15 individuals, with group size determined by fish size.
text_en: Fish were kept in 350-liter aquaria in groups of 5 to 15 individuals, with group size determined by fish size.

quote: Light cycles and seasonal temperature were controlled following natural regimes.
statement: Light cycles and water temperature were regulated to mimic natural seasonal patterns.
text_en: Light cycles and water temperature were regulated to mimic natural seasonal patterns.

quote: Water quality (temperature, oxygen content, levels of nitrate) was regularly monitored and adjusted via biweekly water refreshing.
statement: Key water quality parameters including temperature, oxygen, and nitrate were monitored and maintained through biweekly water changes.
text_en: Key water quality parameters including temperature, oxygen, and nitrate were monitored and maintained through biweekly water changes.

quote: Fish were fed pellets and frozen chironomid larvae (blood worms) on a daily basis (except during winter time when food was provided every other day).
statement: Fish received a diet of pellets and frozen bloodworms daily, reduced to every other day during winter.
text_en: Fish received a diet of pellets and frozen bloodworms daily, reduced to every other day during winter.

quote: When the beginning of spawning was observed, individual fish were caught with dip nets and gametes manually stripped by gently pressing the abdomen.
statement: Spawning fish were captured with dip nets and their gametes were collected via manual abdominal stripping.
text_en: Spawning fish were captured with dip nets and their gametes were collected via manual abdominal stripping.
outcome: handling stress and physical injury risk

quote: However, betaine addition reversed the inhibition effect induced by the high-fat diet.
statement: 然而，添加甜菜碱逆转了由高脂饮食引起的抑制效应。
text_zh: 然而，添加甜菜碱逆转了由高脂饮食引起的抑制效应。
text_en: However, the addition of betaine reversed the inhibitory effect caused by a high-fat diet.
outcome: VLDL组装与分泌相关基因表达

quote: It was also demonstrated that M. rotundus infection can be successfully detected by a simple method, enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA), and that skin mucus collected from infected fish skin had a significantly higher optical density (OD) value than that from uninfected fish.
statement: 研究证明可以通过简单的酶联免疫吸附测定（ELISA）方法成功检测M. rotundus感染，且从受感染鱼皮肤收集的皮肤黏液的光密度（OD）值显著高于未受感染的鱼。
text_zh: 研究证明可以通过简单的酶联免疫吸附测定（ELISA）方法成功检测M. rotundus感染，且从受感染鱼皮肤收集的皮肤黏液的光密度（OD）值显著高于未受感染的鱼。
text_en: Research has demonstrated that M. rotundus infection can be successfully detected using a simple enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) method, and the optical density (OD) values of skin mucus collected from infected fish were significantly higher than those from uninfected fish.

quote: The present study has for the first time demonstrated the successful application of a monoclonal antibody in the detection of myxosporean infections by examining fish skin mucus.
statement: 本研究首次证明了通过检查鱼皮肤黏液使用单克隆抗体检测粘孢子虫感染的成功应用。

text_en: This study demonstrated for the first time the successful application of monoclonal antibody detection of myxosporean infection by examining fish skin mucus.

quote: Although mortalities have seldom been reported, the market value of infected fish is seri-ously reduced due to large visible cysts on the body surface (Lu et al. 2002).
statement: 虽然很少报道死亡率，但由于体表出现大的可见囊肿，受感染鱼的市场价值严重降低。

quote: Early, accurate detection of this infection is crucial, therefore, for its prevention and treatment.
statement: 早期准确检测该感染对于预防和治疗至关重要。

quote: The present study was thus conducted to determine whether a myxosporean infection could be diagnosed by examining fish skin mucus with MAb 2D12.

text_zh: 本研究旨在确定是否可以通过使用MAb 2D12检查鱼皮肤粘液来诊断粘孢子虫感染。
text_en: This study aimed to determine whether myxosporean infection can be diagnosed by examining fish skin mucus using MAb 2D12.

quote: Before sperm collection, the experimental fish were cultured in a tank for 14-day acclimation, keeping them in a greenhouse with a good aquacultural condition.

text_en: Before sperm collection, the experimental fish were acclimated for 14 days in rearing ponds and kept in a greenhouse with good farming conditions.

quote: The aquacultural temperature was kept between 22 and 26 °C.
statement: 养殖温度控制在22至26摄氏度之间。

quote: The feed used was a commercial fish feed with a protein content of 34%.

text_en: The feed used was commercial fish feed with a protein content of 34%.

quote: The tank was continuously aerated to keep the saturated condition of dissolved oxygen.

text_en: The rearing tanks are continuously aerated to maintain dissolved oxygen at saturation.

text_en: Water quality parameters are monitored every morning using a YSI multi-parameter water quality meter.

text_en: Recently, molecular techniques have been used to detect myxosporean infections and even identify their species.

text_en: Antiserum has also been used to detect myxosporeans, although cross-reactions cannot always be avoided.

quote: A monoclonal antibody of high specificity was therefore developed to identify the developmental and sporogonic stages of the proliferative kidney dis-ease pathogen, which is now known as a myxosporean infection (Marin de Mateo et al. 1993).
statement: 因此开发了一种高特异性单克隆抗体，用于识别增殖性肾病病原体的发育期和孢子发生期，该病现被认为是一种黏孢子虫感染。

text_en: Therefore, a highly specific monoclonal antibody was developed to identify the developmental and sporogonic stages of the proliferative kidney disease pathogen, which is now considered a myxosporean infection.

quote: Generally, sperm cryopreservation can cause damage to cells by the ice crystal formed during the cooling and freezing process, which ultimately affects plasma membrane, mitochondria, and chromatin structure [ 9 ].
statement: 通常，精子冷冻保存过程中冷却和冻结形成的冰晶会造成细胞损伤，最终影响质膜、线粒体和染色质结构。

text_en: Usually, ice crystals formed during cooling and freezing in sperm cryopreservation cause cellular damage, ultimately affecting the plasma membrane, mitochondria, and chromatin structure.

quote: In addition, the relative percent survival (RPS) of gibel carp immunized with the polyhedra via an injection route reached 64.71% and 58.82%, respectively, following challenge with CyHV-2.

text_en: In the aquaculture industry, immunization is widely considered the most effective method for preventing viral infections in fish.

quote: Several vaccines have been reported to protect fish from CyHV-2 infection, including an inactivated vaccine [ 27 , 28 ], recombinant subunit vaccine expressed in Pichia pastoris [ 29 ], genetic engineering subunit vaccine based on the baculovirus surface display system [ 30 ], and recombinant baculovirus vector vaccine [ 31 ].
statement: 据报道，几种疫苗可以保护鱼类免受CyHV-2感染，包括灭活疫苗、在毕赤酵母中表达的重组亚单位疫苗、基于杆状病毒表面展示系统的基因工程亚单位疫苗以及重组杆状病毒载体疫苗。

text_en: Several vaccines have been reported to protect fish against CyHV-2 infection, including inactivated vaccines, recombinant subunit vaccines expressed in Pichia pastoris, genetically engineered subunit vaccines based on the baculovirus surface display system, and recombinant baculovirus vector vaccines.

quote: Furthermore, when gibel carp were vaccinated with the purified polyhedra from BmNPV-H1-D4ORF-polh and BmNPV-D4ORF-VP3-polh via injection, the antibody titers in the serum of the vaccinated fish reached 1:6400–1:12,800 at 3 weeks post-vaccination.

731
and systemic disconnection in low learners—parallels the coping style framework,

733
behavioral flexibility, whereas reactive individuals show fragmented physiological
734
states (Koolhaas et al. 1999; Bell et al. 2007).
