text_zh: 两组鱼在相同条件下养殖，水温为24±2°C，pH值为8.0±0.5，溶解氧水平为6.0-10 mg/L。
text_en: Two groups of fish were reared under the same conditions, with a water temperature of 24±2°C, a pH value of 8.0±0.5, and dissolved oxygen levels of 6.0-10 mg/L.

quote: All six cages were placed in the same pond to ensure a consistent rearing environment.
statement: 所有六个网箱放置在同一个池塘中，以确保一致的养殖环境。
text_zh: 所有六个网箱放置在同一个池塘中，以确保一致的养殖环境。
text_en: All six cages were placed in the same pond to ensure a consistent farming environment.

quote: At 4 months of age, fish were fasted for 24 h prior to sampling
statement: 在4月龄时，鱼在采样前禁食24小时。
text_zh: 在4月龄时，鱼在采样前禁食24小时。
text_en: At 4 months of age, the fish were fasted for 24 hours before sampling.

quote: A total of 15 fish from each group were then anesthetized, and blood was collected from the tail vein using 2.5 mL syringes with heparin sodium anticoagulation
statement: 每组共15条鱼被麻醉，并使用装有肝素钠抗凝剂的2.5毫升注射器从尾静脉采集血液。
text_zh: 每组共15条鱼被麻醉，并使用装有肝素钠抗凝剂的2.5毫升注射器从尾静脉采集血液。
text_en: A total of 15 fish per group were anesthetized, and blood was collected from the caudal vein using a 2.5 mL syringe containing heparin sodium anticoagulant.
intervention: Tail vein blood collection after anesthesia

quote: Finally, we observed that the mortality rate of WUCI was slightly higher post A. hydrophila infection when compared to WT, but was not significant (p > 0.05).
statement: 与野生型相比，WUCI在嗜水气单胞菌感染后的死亡率略高，但差异不显著。
text_zh: 与野生型相比，WUCI在嗜水气单胞菌感染后的死亡率略高，但差异不显著。
text_en: Compared to the wild type, WUCI had a slightly higher mortality rate after Aeromonas hydrophila infection, but the difference was not significant.

quote: After hatching, larvae were fed Artemia nauplii 4 times daily until reaching a body length of 2–3 cm, after which, they were transferred to 500 m 2 ponds and fed artificial feed 3 times daily.
statement: 孵化后，幼虫每天喂食卤虫无节幼体4次，直到体长达到2-3厘米，之后转移到500平方米的池塘中，每天喂食人工饲料3次。
text_zh: 孵化后，幼虫每天喂食卤虫无节幼体4次，直到体长达到2-3厘米，之后转移到500平方米的池塘中，每天喂食人工饲料3次。
text_en: After hatching, larvae were fed Artemia nauplii 4 times daily until they reached a body length of 2-3 cm, after which they were transferred to 500 square meter ponds and fed artificial feed 3 times daily.

quote: C. auratus gibelio gill hemorrhagic disease, caused by CyHV-2 infection, has spread widely in gibel carp aquaculture areas, with a 90–100% mortality rate
statement: 由CyHV-2感染引起的异育银鲫鳃出血病在养殖区广泛传播，死亡率为90-100%。
text_zh: 由CyHV-2感染引起的异育银鲫鳃出血病在养殖区广泛传播，死亡率为90-100%。
text_en: Gill hemorrhage disease in allogynogenetic gibel carp caused by CyHV-2 infection is widely spread in farming areas, with a mortality rate of 90-100%.

quote: Vaccine administration is believed to be the most effective approach to prevent and control C. auratus gibelio gill hemorrhagic disease.
statement: 疫苗接种被认为是预防和控制异育银鲫鳃出血病最有效的方法。
text_zh: 疫苗接种被认为是预防和控制异育银鲫鳃出血病最有效的方法。
text_en: Vaccination is considered the most effective method for preventing and controlling gill hemorrhage disease in allogynogenetic crucian carp.

quote: The RPS of gibel carp immunized with baculoviruses displaying and expressing ORF25, ORF25C, and ORF146 by the immersion route reached 83.3%, 87.5%, and 70.8%, respectively
statement: 通过浸泡途径接种展示并表达ORF25、ORF25C和ORF146的杆状病毒的异育银鲫，其相对保护率（RPS）分别达到83.3%、87.5%和70.8%。
text_zh: 通过浸泡途径接种展示并表达ORF25、ORF25C和ORF146的杆状病毒的异育银鲫，其相对保护率（RPS）分别达到83.3%、87.5%和70.8%。
text_en: Allo-gynogenetic gibel carp vaccinated by immersion with baculoviruses displaying and expressing ORF25, ORF25C, and ORF146 achieved relative percent survival (RPS) of 83.3%, 87.5%, and 70.8%, respectively.
intervention_record: 杆状病毒疫苗浸泡免疫

quote: This study reports that the combination of CCL35.2 and pcORF25 significantly enhances the immune protection of gibel carp against CyHV-2 infection, with the highest survival rate being 70%
statement: 该研究报告称，CCL35.2与pcORF25的组合显著增强了异育银鲫对CyHV-2感染的免疫保护，最高存活率为70%。
text_zh: 该研究报告称，CCL35.2与pcORF25的组合显著增强了异育银鲫对CyHV-2感染的免疫保护，最高存活率为70%。
text_en: The study reported that the combination of CCL35.2 and pcORF25 significantly enhanced immune protection against CyHV-2 infection in gibel carp, with a maximum survival rate of 70%.

quote: The RPS of gibel carp immunized with BacCarassius-D4ORF via the oral or injection route reached 59.3% and 80.0%, respectively, following challenge [ 31 ].
statement: 通过口服或注射途径免疫BacCarassius-D4ORF的银鲫在攻毒后的相对保护率（RPS）分别达到59.3%和80.0%。
text_zh: 通过口服或注射途径免疫BacCarassius-D4ORF的银鲫在攻毒后的相对保护率（RPS）分别达到59.3%和80.0%。
text_en: Gibel carp immunized with BacCarassius-D4ORF via oral or injection routes achieved relative percent survival (RPS) of 59.3% and 80.0%, respectively, after challenge.

quote: The infection rate was 85% in the control group injected with complete Freund’s adjuvant, and was 30% and 35% in the immunized groups vaccinated with H1-D4ORF and D4ORF-VP3, respectively.
statement: 注射完全弗氏佐剂的对照组感染率为85%，而接种H1-D4ORF和D4ORF-VP3的免疫组感染率分别为30%和35%。
text_zh: 注射完全弗氏佐剂的对照组感染率为85%，而接种H1-D4ORF和D4ORF-VP3的免疫组感染率分别为30%和35%。
text_en: The infection rate in the control group injected with complete Freund's adjuvant was 85%, while the infection rates in the immunized groups vaccinated with H1-D4ORF and D4ORF-VP3 were 30% and 35%, respectively.

quote: The RPS for immunized groups was 64.71% and 58.82% for H1-D4ORF and D4ORF-VP3, respectively (Table 1).
statement: H1-D4ORF和D4ORF-VP3免疫组的相对存活率（RPS）分别为64.71%和58.82%。
text_zh: H1-D4ORF和D4ORF-VP3免疫组的相对存活率（RPS）分别为64.71%和58.82%。
text_en: The relative percent survival (RPS) of the H1-D4ORF and D4ORF-VP3 immunization groups were 64.71% and 58.82%, respectively.

quote: Other studies showed that baculovirus vector vaccines against grass carp reovirus (GCRV) and CyHV-2 orally administered to grass carp, as well as gibel carp, induced good immunoprotection [ 31 , 34 ].
statement: 其他研究表明，针对草鱼呼肠孤病毒(GCRV)和鲤疱疹病毒2型(CyHV-2)的杆状病毒载体疫苗经口给予草鱼和鲫鱼后，诱导了良好的免疫保护。
text_zh: 其他研究表明，针对草鱼呼肠孤病毒(GCRV)和鲤疱疹病毒2型(CyHV-2)的杆状病毒载体疫苗经口给予草鱼和鲫鱼后，诱导了良好的免疫保护。
text_en: Other studies have shown that baculovirus vector vaccines against grass carp reovirus (GCRV) and cyprinid herpesvirus 2 (CyHV-2), when administered orally to grass carp and crucian carp, induced good immune protection.
intervention_record: 杆状病毒载体疫苗口服

quote: In a similar study, an oral Bacillus carrier vaccine against GCRV protected 50–60% of grass carp from infection with GCRV [ 37 ].
statement: 在一项类似研究中，针对GCRV的芽孢杆菌载体口服疫苗保护了50-60%的草鱼免受GCRV感染。
text_zh: 在一项类似研究中，针对GCRV的芽孢杆菌载体口服疫苗保护了50-60%的草鱼免受GCRV感染。
text_en: In a similar study, an oral Bacillus vector vaccine against GCRV protected 50-60% of grass carp from GCRV infection.
intervention_record: 芽孢杆菌载体疫苗口服

quote: Moreover, orally immunized carp and koi with a genetically engineered Lactobacillus plantarum surface displaying G protein of the spring viremia of carp virus (SVCV) combined with the ORF81 protein of koi herpesvirus showed effective protection rates of 71% and 53%, respectively [ 38 ].
statement: 此外，使用表面展示鲤鱼春病毒血症病毒(SVCV)G蛋白并联合锦鲤疱疹病毒ORF81蛋白的基因工程植物乳杆菌对鲤鱼和锦鲤进行口服免疫，分别显示出71%和53%的有效保护率。
text_zh: 此外，使用表面展示鲤鱼春病毒血症病毒(SVCV)G蛋白并联合锦鲤疱疹病毒ORF81蛋白的基因工程植物乳杆菌对鲤鱼和锦鲤进行口服免疫，分别显示出71%和53%的有效保护率。
text_en: In addition, oral immunization of common carp and koi with genetically engineered Lactobacillus plantarum displaying the spring viremia of carp virus (SVCV) G protein on its surface in combination with the koi herpesvirus ORF81 protein showed protective efficacy rates of 71% and 53%, respectively.

quote: However, when carp received paraformaldehyde-fixed whole insect Sf9 cells expressing SVCV-G protein by oral vaccination with alginate-encapsulated cells, no protection against SVCV was detected [ 39 ].
statement: 然而，当鲤鱼通过海藻酸盐封装细胞口服接种表达SVCV-G蛋白的多聚甲醛固定全昆虫Sf9细胞时，未检测到对SVCV的保护作用。
text_zh: 然而，当鲤鱼通过海藻酸盐封装细胞口服接种表达SVCV-G蛋白的多聚甲醛固定全昆虫Sf9细胞时，未检测到对SVCV的保护作用。
text_en: However, when carp were orally vaccinated with formaldehyde-fixed whole Sf9 insect cells expressing SVCV-G protein encapsulated in alginate, no protective effect against SVCV was detected.
intervention_record: 海藻酸盐封装口服疫苗

quote: The activities of trypsin, α-amylase (α-AL), lipase (LPS), superoxide dismutase (SOD), catalase (CAT), acid phosphatase (ACP), and alkaline phosphatase (AKP), as well as the content of malondialdehyde (MDA), were measured according to the manufacturer’s protocols (Suzhou Grace Biotechnology Co., Suzhou, China).
statement: 根据制造商方案测定胰蛋白酶、α-淀粉酶、脂肪酶、超氧化物歧化酶、过氧化氢酶、酸性磷酸酶、碱性磷酸酶的活性以及丙二醛的含量。
text_zh: 根据制造商方案测定胰蛋白酶、α-淀粉酶、脂肪酶、超氧化物歧化酶、过氧化氢酶、酸性磷酸酶、碱性磷酸酶的活性以及丙二醛的含量。
text_en: The activities of trypsin, α-amylase, lipase, superoxide dismutase, catalase, acid phosphatase, and alkaline phosphatase, as well as the content of malondialdehyde, were determined according to the manufacturer's protocols.
outcome: 消化功能与抗氧化能力

quote: Previous studies have reported that dietary supplementations with astaxanthin and Ginkgo biloba leaf extract show enhanced WBC levels in common carp, high resistance to A. hydrophila, and reduced mortality from infection
statement: 先前的研究报告称，在鲤鱼日粮中添加虾青素和银杏叶提取物可提高白细胞水平、增强对嗜水气单胞菌的抵抗力并降低感染死亡率。
text_zh: 先前的研究报告称，在鲤鱼日粮中添加虾青素和银杏叶提取物可提高白细胞水平、增强对嗜水气单胞菌的抵抗力并降低感染死亡率。
text_en: Previous research reports have stated that adding astaxanthin and Ginkgo biloba leaf extract to carp diets can increase white blood cell levels, enhance resistance to Aeromonas hydrophila, and reduce infection mortality.
intervention_record: 虾青素和银杏叶提取物日粮

quote: A. hydrophila infections cause visible damage to the exterior of fish, leading to severe internal infections, and reducing the immune capability of fish [ 62 ].
statement: 嗜水气单胞菌感染会导致鱼类体表可见损伤，引发严重内部感染并降低鱼类的免疫能力。
text_zh: 嗜水气单胞菌感染会导致鱼类体表可见损伤，引发严重内部感染并降低鱼类的免疫能力。
text_en: Aeromonas hydrophila infection causes visible skin lesions in fish, triggers severe internal infections, and reduces the immune capacity of fish.

quote: However, WUCI showed lower WBC levels and an increased susceptibility to A. hydrophila infection, with delayed and weaker inflammatory responses compared to WT.
statement: 然而，与野生型相比，WUCI显示出较低的白细胞水平和增加的嗜水气单胞菌感染易感性，且炎症反应延迟并减弱。
text_zh: 然而，与野生型相比，WUCI显示出较低的白细胞水平和增加的嗜水气单胞菌感染易感性，且炎症反应延迟并减弱。
text_en: However, compared to the wild type, WUCI showed lower white blood cell levels and increased susceptibility to Aeromonas hydrophila infection, with a delayed and attenuated inflammatory response.
outcome: 免疫应答与疾病易感性

quote: In general, while WUCI exhibited improved growth and unique metabolic characteristics, its disease resistance was slightly weaker to WT, but there was no significant difference in infection mortality rate compared to WT.
statement: 总体而言，虽然WUCI表现出改善的生长和独特的代谢特征，但其抗病能力略弱于野生型，不过与野生型相比，感染死亡率没有显著差异。
text_zh: 总体而言，虽然WUCI表现出改善的生长和独特的代谢特征，但其抗病能力略弱于野生型，不过与野生型相比，感染死亡率没有显著差异。
text_en: Overall, although WUCI showed improved growth and unique metabolic characteristics, its disease resistance was slightly weaker than that of the wild type; however, there was no significant difference in infection mortality compared to the wild type.

quote: The RPS of gibel carp immunized with the multi-subunit vaccine encapsulated by polyhedra via a single injection immunization reached 58.8–64.7% following challenge with CyHV-2.
statement: 通过单次注射免疫由多角体包裹的多亚基疫苗的银鲫，在CyHV-2攻毒后的相对保护率（RPS）达到58.8–64.7%。
text_zh: 通过单次注射免疫由多角体包裹的多亚基疫苗的银鲫，在CyHV-2攻毒后的相对保护率（RPS）达到58.8–64.7%。
text_en: Crucian carp immunized by a single injection with a polyhedron-encapsulated multi-subunit vaccine achieved a relative percent survival (RPS) of 58.8–64.7% after CyHV-2 challenge.

quote: However, the RPS of immunized fish with polyhedra incorporating H1-D4ORF and D4ORF-VP3 proteins was lower compared with previous reports.
statement: 然而，与之前的报道相比，用整合了H1-D4ORF和D4ORF-VP3蛋白的多角体免疫的鱼其相对保护率较低。
text_zh: 然而，与之前的报道相比，用整合了H1-D4ORF和D4ORF-VP3蛋白的多角体免疫的鱼其相对保护率较低。
text_en: However, compared with previous reports, the relative protection rate of fish immunized with occlusion bodies integrating H1-D4ORF and D4ORF-VP3 proteins was lower.

quote: The fish were deeply anesthetized with 100 mg/L MS-222 (Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, MO, United States) before dissection.
statement: 实验前使用100 mg/L的MS-222对鱼进行深度麻醉。
text_zh: 实验前使用100 mg/L的MS-222对鱼进行深度麻醉。
text_en: Fish were deeply anesthetized with 100 mg/L MS-222 before the experiment.
outcome: 屠宰/处理前的应激控制

quote: The degree of oxidative stress within the body could be assessed through the measurement of MDA, which serves as a lipid peroxidation indicator
statement: MDA的测定可用于评估体内的氧化应激程度，因为它是脂质过氧化的指标。
text_zh: MDA的测定可用于评估体内的氧化应激程度，因为它是脂质过氧化的指标。
text_en: MDA measurement can be used to assess the degree of oxidative stress in the body, as it is an indicator of lipid peroxidation.

quote: A total of 30 C . carassius accommodated at 26°C were used in this experiment (n = 10 for each group).
statement: 本实验使用了30条在26°C下适应的鲫鱼，每组10条。
text_zh: 本实验使用了30条在26°C下适应的鲫鱼，每组10条。
text_en: This experiment used 30 crucian carp acclimated at 26°C, with 10 fish per group.

quote: The expression of TNF-α , IL-1β , IL-6 , IL-10 , TGF-β , and hepcidin mRNA in WT increased sharply and reached a peak on day 1 post-infection with A. hydrophila , followed by a decrease.
statement: 野生型（WT）鱼中TNF-α、IL-1β、IL-6、IL-10、TGF-β和铁调素的mRNA表达在感染嗜水气单胞菌后第1天急剧增加并达到峰值，随后下降。
text_zh: 野生型（WT）鱼中TNF-α、IL-1β、IL-6、IL-10、TGF-β和铁调素的mRNA表达在感染嗜水气单胞菌后第1天急剧增加并达到峰值，随后下降。
text_en: In wild-type (WT) fish, mRNA expression of TNF-α, IL-1β, IL-6, IL-10, TGF-β and hepcidin increased sharply and peaked on day 1 after infection with Aeromonas hydrophila, then declined.
outcome: 炎症反应/细胞因子表达

quote: Exogenous supplementation of fructose increases fish survival rate by 27.2%.
statement: 外源补充果糖使鱼的存活率提高了27.2%。
text_zh: 外源补充果糖使鱼的存活率提高了27.2%。
text_en: Exogenous fructose supplementation increased fish survival rate by 27.2%.

quote: Furthermore, the augmented lysozyme and C3 levels enhance serum cell lytic activity which contribute to the reduced bacterial load in vivo .
statement: 此外，增加的溶菌酶和C3水平增强了血清细胞裂解活性，这有助于减少体内的细菌载量。
text_zh: 此外，增加的溶菌酶和C3水平增强了血清细胞裂解活性，这有助于减少体内的细菌载量。
text_en: In addition, increased lysozyme and C3 levels enhanced serum bactericidal activity, which helped reduce the bacterial load in the body.

quote: fish (n = 10 for each group) were anaesthetized on ice for 10 min to slow the movement of the fish.
statement: 鱼在冰上麻醉10分钟以减缓其运动。
text_zh: 鱼在冰上麻醉10分钟以减缓其运动。
text_en: Fish were anesthetized on ice for 10 minutes to slow their movement.

quote: Blood samples were collected with sterile syringes from the caudal vein around the caudal peduncle into 1.7-ml microcentrifuge tubes without anticoagulants.
statement: 使用无菌注射器从尾柄周围的尾静脉采集血液样本至不含抗凝剂的微量离心管中。
text_zh: 使用无菌注射器从尾柄周围的尾静脉采集血液样本至不含抗凝剂的微量离心管中。
text_en: Blood samples were collected from the caudal vein around the caudal peduncle using a sterile syringe into microcentrifuge tubes without anticoagulant.
outcome: 采样操作对动物的影响

quote: Administration of fructose to the fish increased their survival from 46.67% to 76.67%.
statement: 向鱼体内施用果糖使其存活率从46.67%提高到76.67%。
text_zh: 向鱼体内施用果糖使其存活率从46.67%提高到76.67%。
text_en: Administering fructose to fish increased their survival rate from 46.67% to 76.67%.

quote: Therefore, we identified fructose as a crucial biomarker, whose abundance was decreased in the dying fish.
statement: 因此，我们将果糖鉴定为一种关键的生物标志物，其在濒死鱼体内的丰度降低。
text_zh: 因此，我们将果糖鉴定为一种关键的生物标志物，其在濒死鱼体内的丰度降低。
text_en: Therefore, we identified fructose as a key biomarker whose abundance decreases in dying fish.
outcome: 疾病状态下的代谢标志物

quote: Interestingly, the three groups were separately clustered, suggesting that the dying fish and survival fish mounted differential response, which were also different from the saline control group (Figure 1C).
statement: 代谢组学聚类分析显示，濒死鱼和存活鱼的反应不同，且均与盐水对照组不同。
text_zh: 代谢组学聚类分析显示，濒死鱼和存活鱼的反应不同，且均与盐水对照组不同。
text_en: Metabolomics cluster analysis showed that the responses of dying fish and surviving fish were different, and both differed from the saline control group.

quote: These data together suggest that the metabolome is associated with the state of fish during bacterial infection, highlighting the differential metabolic response in the dying and survival fish.
statement: 数据表明代谢组与鱼类细菌感染期间的状态相关，突出了濒死和存活鱼之间的差异代谢反应。
text_zh: 数据表明代谢组与鱼类细菌感染期间的状态相关，突出了濒死和存活鱼之间的差异代谢反应。
text_en: Data indicate that the metabolome is associated with the status during bacterial infection in fish, highlighting differential metabolic responses between moribund and surviving fish.
outcome: 细菌感染期间的健康状态

quote: Crucian carp, Carassius carassius , were infected with serial doses of A. hydrophila (5 × 10 5 , 1 × 10 6 , 2 × 10 6 , 3 × 10 6 , 4 × 10 6 CFU/fish) by intraperitoneal injection.
statement: 鲫鱼通过腹腔注射不同剂量的嗜水气单胞菌进行感染。
text_zh: 鲫鱼通过腹腔注射不同剂量的嗜水气单胞菌进行感染。
text_en: Crucian carp were infected by intraperitoneal injection of different doses of Aeromonas hydrophila.

quote: Fish began to die as early as 24 h postinfection and did not die after 72 h postinfection (Figure 1A).
statement: 鱼在感染后最早24小时开始死亡，且在感染后72小时后不再死亡。
text_zh: 鱼在感染后最早24小时开始死亡，且在感染后72小时后不再死亡。
text_en: Fish began dying as early as 24 hours post-infection, and no further deaths occurred after 72 hours post-infection.

quote: Moreover, the dose (3 × 10 6 CFU) causing 50% of death was selected as LD 50 , which was used for following analysis.
statement: 导致50%死亡的剂量（3 × 10^6 CFU）被选定为LD50，并用于后续分析。
text_zh: 导致50%死亡的剂量（3 × 10^6 CFU）被选定为LD50，并用于后续分析。
text_en: The dose causing 50% mortality (3 × 10^6 CFU) was selected as the LD50 and used for subsequent analysis.
outcome: 毒性评估/实验设计参数

quote: To understand the metabolic signature that determines the consequences of A. hydrophila infection, C. carassius was challenged with A. hydrophila at LD 50 .
statement: 为了理解决定嗜水气单胞菌感染后果的代谢特征，使用LD50剂量的嗜水气单胞菌对鲤鲫进行了攻击实验。
text_zh: 为了理解决定嗜水气单胞菌感染后果的代谢特征，使用LD50剂量的嗜水气单胞菌对鲤鲫进行了攻击实验。
text_en: To understand the metabolic characteristics that determine the consequences of Aeromonas hydrophila infection, crucian carp were challenged with a LD50 dose of A. hydrophila.

quote: C. carassius (n = 90) were randomly divided into three groups, acclimatized for 7 days at 28°C.
statement: 鲫鱼被随机分为三组，并在28°C下驯化7天。
text_zh: 鲫鱼被随机分为三组，并在28°C下驯化7天。
text_en: Crucian carp were randomly divided into three groups and acclimated at 28°C for 7 days.

quote: After the treatment, fish were challenged by intraperitoneal injection of 6.25 × 10 6 CFU/fish A. hydrophila .
statement: 处理后，通过腹腔注射每鱼6.25×10^6 CFU的气单胞菌对鱼进行攻击。
text_zh: 处理后，通过腹腔注射每鱼6.25×10^6 CFU的气单胞菌对鱼进行攻击。
text_en: After treatment, fish were challenged by intraperitoneal injection of Aeromonas at 6.25×10^6 CFU per fish.
outcome: 疾病易感性与感染压力

quote: Crucian carp were observed for 10 days for accumulative death.
statement: 观察鲫鱼10天的累积死亡情况。
text_zh: 观察鲫鱼10天的累积死亡情况。
text_en: Observe the cumulative mortality of crucian carp over 10 days.

quote: recirculating aquaculture system and fed once a day with commercial fish food.
statement: 鱼类在循环水养殖系统中饲养，每天喂食一次商业鱼饲料。
text_zh: 鱼类在循环水养殖系统中饲养，每天喂食一次商业鱼饲料。
text_en: Fish were reared in a recirculating aquaculture system and fed commercial fish feed once daily.

quote: The fish culture room was equipped with normal light at a rhythm of 12-h/12-h light and darkness.
statement: 养鱼室配备正常光照，光暗周期为12小时/12小时。
text_zh: 养鱼室配备正常光照，光暗周期为12小时/12小时。
text_en: The fish room is equipped with normal lighting, with a light-dark cycle of 12 hours/12 hours.

quote: For bacterial infection, Carassius carassius were individually challenged with 5 μl of 1 × 10 6 CFU bacterial suspension or saline only via intraperitoneal injection (n = 20 for each treatment).
statement: 通过腹腔注射将鲫鱼个体暴露于嗜水气单胞菌悬浮液或生理盐水中以进行细菌感染挑战。
text_zh: 通过腹腔注射将鲫鱼个体暴露于嗜水气单胞菌悬浮液或生理盐水中以进行细菌感染挑战。
text_en: Individual crucian carp were exposed to Aeromonas hydrophila suspension or saline via intraperitoneal injection for bacterial infection challenge.

quote: Fish mortality was examined twice daily for 10 days to monitor accumulative death.
statement: 每天两次检查鱼的死亡率，持续10天，以监测累积死亡情况。
text_zh: 每天两次检查鱼的死亡率，持续10天，以监测累积死亡情况。
text_en: Fish mortality was checked twice a day for 10 days to monitor cumulative deaths.

quote: the main symptoms of the fish being infected by A. hydrophila is associated with necrosis, ascitic fluid, and darkening of the spleen and kidney and pale liver (10), and the fish dies within 3 days (11).
statement: 受嗜水气单胞菌感染的鱼类主要症状包括坏死、腹水、脾脏和肾脏变黑以及肝脏苍白，且鱼在3天内死亡。
text_zh: 受嗜水气单胞菌感染的鱼类主要症状包括坏死、腹水、脾脏和肾脏变黑以及肝脏苍白，且鱼在3天内死亡。
text_en: Fish infected with Aeromonas hydrophila mainly show symptoms including necrosis, ascites, blackening of the spleen and kidneys, and pale liver, and die within 3 days.

quote: Broad-spectrum antibiotics including tetracyclines/cefotaxime and quinolones were routinely used to treat A. hydrophila infection (14).
statement: 包括四环素/头孢噻肟和喹诺酮类在内的广谱抗生素曾被常规用于治疗嗜水气单胞菌感染。
text_zh: 包括四环素/头孢噻肟和喹诺酮类在内的广谱抗生素曾被常规用于治疗嗜水气单胞菌感染。
text_en: Broad-spectrum antibiotics, including tetracycline/cefotaxime and quinolones, have been routinely used to treat Aeromonas hydrophila infections.

quote: However, the misuse and overuse of antibiotic increase the prevalence of antibiotic resistance and the global spread of antibiotic-resistant genes, limiting the therapeutic effects of antibiotics (15).
statement: 然而，抗生素的滥用和过度使用增加了抗生素耐药性的流行率和耐药基因的全球传播，限制了抗生素的治疗效果。
text_zh: 然而，抗生素的滥用和过度使用增加了抗生素耐药性的流行率和耐药基因的全球传播，限制了抗生素的治疗效果。
text_en: However, the misuse and overuse of antibiotics have increased the prevalence of antibiotic resistance and the global spread of resistance genes, limiting the therapeutic effectiveness of antibiotics.

quote: Fructose (50µg) A. hydrophila 30 20 33.33 37.5 b Fructose (100µg) A. hydrophila 30 23 23.33 56.25 b
statement: 注射50µg和100µg果糖的鲫鱼在感染嗜水气单胞菌后的存活率分别为66.67%和76.67%，相对存活保护率（RPS）分别为37.5%和56.25%。
text_zh: 注射50µg和100µg果糖的鲫鱼在感染嗜水气单胞菌后的存活率分别为66.67%和76.67%，相对存活保护率（RPS）分别为37.5%和56.25%。
text_en: Crucian carp injected with 50 µg and 100 µg of fructose had survival rates of 66.67% and 76.67%, respectively, after infection with Aeromonas hydrophila, with relative percent survival (RPS) values of 37.5% and 56.25%, respectively.

quote: The lysozyme activity was increased from 64.53 ± 2.31 to 105.48 ± 4.51 U/ml, and the complement activity was increased from 28.55 ± 1.36 to 45.53 ± 3.11 U/ml
statement: 经100 µg果糖处理后，鲫鱼的溶菌酶活性从64.53 ± 2.31 U/ml增加至105.48 ± 4.51 U/ml，补体活性从28.55 ± 1.36 U/ml增加至45.53 ± 3.11 U/ml。
text_en: 经100 µg果糖处理后，鲫鱼的溶菌酶活性从64.53 ± 2.31 U/ml增加至105.48 ± 4.51 U/ml，补体活性从28.55 ± 1.36 U/ml增加至45.53 ± 3.11 U/ml。

quote: We postulate that fructose promotes the serum level of lysozyme and complement component 3 that help the elimination of bacteria
statement: 作者推测果糖通过提高血清中溶菌酶和补体成分3的水平来帮助消除细菌。
text_zh: 作者推测果糖通过提高血清中溶菌酶和补体成分3的水平来帮助消除细菌。
text_en: The authors speculate that fructose helps eliminate bacteria by increasing the levels of lysozyme and complement component 3 in serum.

quote: However, upon bacterial challenge, fructose increased the C. carassius survival rate up to 27.2% in a fructose dose-dependent manner (Figure 4A), where injection of saline served as control.
statement: 然而，在细菌攻击后，果糖以剂量依赖的方式将鲫鱼（C. carassius）的存活率提高了高达27.2%，其中注射生理盐水作为对照。
text_zh: 然而，在细菌攻击后，果糖以剂量依赖的方式将鲫鱼（C. carassius）的存活率提高了高达27.2%，其中注射生理盐水作为对照。
text_en: However, after bacterial challenge, fructose increased the survival rate of crucian carp (C. carassius) in a dose-dependent manner by up to 27.2%, with saline injection serving as the control.

quote: The relative percent survival rates of the two groups were 37.5% and 56.25% for the groups being treated with 50 and 100 μg/fish, respectively (Table 1).
statement: 接受50和100微克/鱼处理的两个组的相对存活百分比分别为37.5%和56.25%。
text_zh: 接受50和100微克/鱼处理的两个组的相对存活百分比分别为37.5%和56.25%。
text_en: The relative survival percentages of the two groups treated with 50 and 100 micrograms/fish were 37.5% and 56.25%, respectively.

quote: Glucose increased fish survival by 14% to 60% upon Edwardsiella tarda infection (25 , 26).
statement: 葡萄糖在爱德华氏菌感染时使鱼类存活率提高了14%至60%。
text_zh: 葡萄糖在爱德华氏菌感染时使鱼类存活率提高了14%至60%。
text_en: Glucose increased fish survival rates by 14% to 60% during Edwardsiella infection.

quote: L-Aspartic acid, L-leucine, and L-valine increase tilapia survival against both gram-positive and -negative pathogens (27 – 30).
statement: L-天冬氨酸、L-亮氨酸和L-缬氨酸增加了罗非鱼对革兰氏阳性菌和阴性菌病原体的存活率。
text_zh: L-天冬氨酸、L-亮氨酸和L-缬氨酸增加了罗非鱼对革兰氏阳性菌和阴性菌病原体的存活率。
text_en: L-aspartic acid, L-leucine and L-valine increased the survival rate of tilapia against Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacterial pathogens.
intervention_record: 天冬氨酸亮氨酸缬氨酸

quote: Moreover, other metabolites such as myo-inositol (31), maltose (32), l-proline (29), and malate (33) increase important aquatic fish—such as crucian carp—survival rates by 14% to 60%.
statement: 肌醇、麦芽糖、L-脯氨酸和苹果酸等其他代谢物将重要水产鱼类（如鲫鱼）的存活率提高了14%至60%。
text_zh: 肌醇、麦芽糖、L-脯氨酸和苹果酸等其他代谢物将重要水产鱼类（如鲫鱼）的存活率提高了14%至60%。
text_en: Other metabolites such as inositol, maltose, L-proline and malic acid increased the survival rate of important farmed fish species (such as crucian carp) by 14% to 60%.
intervention: Inositol, maltose, proline and malic acid
intervention_record: 肌醇麦芽糖脯氨酸苹果酸

quote: Furthermore, the expression of TLR4, IL-1β, IL-6, and IL-10 was up-regulated at 24 h post infection in the common carp (Cyprinus carpio) spleen in response to A. hydrophila [ 70 ].
statement: 此外，普通鲤鱼脾脏中TLR4、IL-1β、IL-6和IL-10的表达在嗜水气单胞菌感染后24小时上调。
text_zh: 此外，普通鲤鱼脾脏中TLR4、IL-1β、IL-6和IL-10的表达在嗜水气单胞菌感染后24小时上调。
text_en: In addition, the expression of TLR4, IL-1β, IL-6 and IL-10 in the spleen of common carp was upregulated 24 hours after Aeromonas hydrophila infection.

quote: Previous transcriptome results revealed that the expression of IL-1β, TNF-α, and IL-10 in the spleen of grass carp (Ctenopharyngodon idellus) infected with A. hydrophila was up-regulated in the early stages [ 78 ].
statement: 先前的转录组结果显示，感染嗜水气单胞菌的草鱼脾脏中IL-1β、TNF-α和IL-10的表达在早期阶段上调。
text_zh: 先前的转录组结果显示，感染嗜水气单胞菌的草鱼脾脏中IL-1β、TNF-α和IL-10的表达在早期阶段上调。
text_en: Previous transcriptome results showed that the expression of IL-1β, TNF-α and IL-10 in the spleen of grass carp infected with Aeromonas hydrophila was upregulated in the early stage.

quote: In this study, WUCI exhibited a delayed inflammatory response to A. hydrophila infection compared to WT, and the peak levels of TNF-α, IL-1 β, IL-10, and TGF-β mRNA were lower than those of WT, indicating that although WUCI had a certain degree of resistance to A. hydrophila infection, its overall immune response was inferior to that of WT, making it more susceptible to infection or more difficult to control infection effe
statement: 本研究中，WUCI对嗜水气单胞菌感染的炎症反应较WT延迟，且TNF-α、IL-1β、IL-10和TGF-β mRNA的峰值水平低于WT，表明尽管WUCI对嗜水气单胞菌感染具有一定程度的抵抗力，但其整体免疫反应劣于WT，使其更容易受到感染或更难控制感染效果。
text_zh: 本研究中，WUCI对嗜水气单胞菌感染的炎症反应较WT延迟，且TNF-α、IL-1β、IL-10和TGF-β mRNA的峰值水平低于WT，表明尽管WUCI对嗜水气单胞菌感染具有一定程度的抵抗力，但其整体免疫反应劣于WT，使其更容易受到感染或更难控制感染效果。
text_en: In this study, the inflammatory response of WUCI to Aeromonas hydrophila infection was delayed compared to WT, and the peak levels of TNF-α, IL-1β, IL-10 and TGF-β mRNA were lower than in WT, indicating that although WUCI has a certain degree of resistance to Aeromonas hydrophila infection, its overall immune response is inferior to that of WT, making it more susceptible to infection or less able to control the infection.
counterevidence: WUCI的整体免疫反应劣于野生型（WT），导致其更易感或难以控制感染。

quote: creased the expression of lysozyme and C3 at both transcriptional level and protein levels.
statement: 果糖处理增加了溶菌酶和C3在转录水平和蛋白水平的表达。
text_zh: 果糖处理增加了溶菌酶和C3在转录水平和蛋白水平的表达。
text_en: Fructose treatment increased the expression of lysozyme and C3 at both the transcriptional and protein levels.

quote: As compared to the saline control, the bacteria grew dramatically in the control, whose CFU increased 10.36-fold, whereas the growth in the fructose serum was slowed for 1.9-fold as compared to serum alone (Figure 5C).
statement: 与单独血清相比，来自果糖处理鱼的血清使细菌生长速度减慢了1.9倍。
text_zh: 与单独血清相比，来自果糖处理鱼的血清使细菌生长速度减慢了1.9倍。
text_en: Compared to serum alone, serum from fructose-treated fish slowed bacterial growth by a factor of 1.9.

quote: These data together suggest that fructose increased the humoral lytic ability toward A. hydrophila.
statement: 数据表明果糖增加了对嗜水气单胞菌的体液裂解能力。
text_zh: 数据表明果糖增加了对嗜水气单胞菌的体液裂解能力。
text_en: The data indicate that fructose increased the humoral lytic ability against Aeromonas hydrophila.

quote: we firstly established that the number of bacteria in the survival fish was around 63.31-fold lower than that in the dying fish (Figure 6
statement: 存活鱼体内的细菌数量比濒死鱼低约63.31倍。
text_zh: 存活鱼体内的细菌数量比濒死鱼低约63.31倍。
text_en: The bacterial count in surviving fish was about 63.31 times lower than that in moribund fish.

quote: While ﬁsh in each clonal line were being exposed to thermal stress at 36.5 ± 0.5°C, the responses were measured as survival rates and mean death times
statement: 在每条克隆系中，鱼暴露于36.5 ± 0.5°C的热应激下时，其反应通过存活率和平均死亡时间进行测量。
text_zh: 在每条克隆系中，鱼暴露于36.5 ± 0.5°C的热应激下时，其反应通过存活率和平均死亡时间进行测量。
text_en: In each clone line, the response of fish exposed to heat stress at 36.5 ± 0.5°C was measured by survival rate and mean time to death.

quote: The number of viable bacteria was a critical factor for fish survival.
statement: 活菌数量是鱼类存活的关键因素。
text_zh: 活菌数量是鱼类存活的关键因素。
text_en: The number of live bacteria is a key factor in fish survival.

quote: Under an LD50 dose challenge, the control group had an increased number of bacteria in 36 h after intraperitoneal infection, which increased 61.44-fold after 36 h postinfection (Figure 6B).
statement: 在LD50剂量攻击下，对照组腹腔感染后36小时细菌数量增加，感染后36小时增加了61.44倍。
text_zh: 在LD50剂量攻击下，对照组腹腔感染后36小时细菌数量增加，感染后36小时增加了61.44倍。

quote: However, the number in fructose-treated fish was increased less than 9.17-fold at the first 24 h but decreased afterward (Figure 6B).
statement: 然而，果糖处理鱼的前24小时内细菌数量增加少于9.17倍，随后减少。
text_zh: 然而，果糖处理鱼的前24小时内细菌数量增加少于9.17倍，随后减少。
text_en: However, the bacterial count in fructose-treated fish increased by less than 9.17 times within the first 24 hours, and then decreased.

quote: we indeed found that fructose enhances the expression of innate humoral molecules including lysozyme and c3 at both transcriptional and protein levels.
statement: 果糖在转录和蛋白质水平上增强了包括溶菌酶和C3在内的先天体液分子的表达。
text_zh: 果糖在转录和蛋白质水平上增强了包括溶菌酶和C3在内的先天体液分子的表达。
text_en: Fructose enhanced the expression of innate humoral molecules, including lysozyme and C3, at the transcriptional and protein levels.

quote: The identification of fructose as a survival-promoting factor was interesting.
statement: 将果糖鉴定为一种促进存活的因子是有趣的。
text_zh: 将果糖鉴定为一种促进存活的因子是有趣的。
text_en: It is interesting to identify fructose as a survival-promoting factor.

quote: The increased fish survival motivated us to investigate whether this potential was driven by immunity.
statement: 果糖处理导致的鱼类存活率增加促使研究者调查其是否由免疫驱动。
text_zh: 果糖处理导致的鱼类存活率增加促使研究者调查其是否由免疫驱动。
text_en: The increase in fish survival rate caused by fructose treatment prompted researchers to investigate whether it was driven by immunity.

quote: Consistently, lyz and c3 were the two of the most impacted genes (Figure 4C) that increased 4.13- and 2.99-fold, respectively.
statement: 在感染后，lyz和c3是受影响最大的两个基因，分别增加了4.13倍和2.99倍。
text_zh: 在感染后，lyz和c3是受影响最大的两个基因，分别增加了4.13倍和2.99倍。
text_en: After infection, lyz and c3 were the two most affected genes, increasing by 4.13-fold and 2.99-fold, respectively.
intervention: Fructose pretreatment then A. hydrophila infection

quote: Thus, these data suggest that fructose influence gene expression that can enhance C. carassius to fight against A. hydrophila infection.
statement: 这些数据表明果糖影响基因表达，从而增强鲫鱼对抗嗜水气单胞菌感染的能力。
text_zh: 这些数据表明果糖影响基因表达，从而增强鲫鱼对抗嗜水气单胞菌感染的能力。
text_en: These data indicate that fructose affects gene expression, thereby enhancing the ability of crucian carp to resist Aeromonas hydrophila infection.

quote: we established the metabolic signature of C. carassius upon A. hydrophila infection and identify fructose as a metabolite in promoting C. carassius survival.
statement: 研究确定了鲫鱼在嗜水气单胞菌感染下的代谢特征，并鉴定出果糖是一种促进鲫鱼存活的代谢物。
text_zh: 研究确定了鲫鱼在嗜水气单胞菌感染下的代谢特征，并鉴定出果糖是一种促进鲫鱼存活的代谢物。
text_en: The study identified the metabolic characteristics of crucian carp under Aeromonas hydrophila infection and determined that fructose is a metabolite that promotes the survival of crucian carp.

quote: We also report that fructose mainly enhances the expression of lysozyme and C3, which enable the bacteria to be reduced more efficiently (Figure 7), thus highlighting a metabolism-based approach to combat bacterial infection in aquaculture.
statement: 报告指出果糖主要增强溶菌酶和补体成分3的表达，从而更有效地减少细菌，突显了基于代谢的方法用于对抗水产养殖中的细菌感染。
text_zh: 报告指出果糖主要增强溶菌酶和补体成分3的表达，从而更有效地减少细菌，突显了基于代谢的方法用于对抗水产养殖中的细菌感染。
text_en: The report indicates that fructose mainly enhances the expression of lysozyme and complement component 3, thereby more effectively reducing bacteria, highlighting metabolism-based approaches for combating bacterial infections in aquaculture.

quote: Combating bacterial infection is required for the sustainable development of aquaculture that is of increasing importance to provide the protein sources to end hunger (58 , 59).
statement: 对抗细菌感染对于水产养殖的可持续发展至关重要。
text_zh: 对抗细菌感染对于水产养殖的可持续发展至关重要。
text_en: Combating bacterial infections is crucial for the sustainable development of aquaculture.
outcome: 疾病防控与产业可持续性

quote: In addition to the currently developed strategies, boosting the host’s immunity by metabolites is highly appreciated due to their eco-friendly, inexpensive, and nutritional characteristics (20).
statement: 通过代谢物增强宿主免疫力因其环保、廉价和营养特性而备受推崇。
text_zh: 通过代谢物增强宿主免疫力因其环保、廉价和营养特性而备受推崇。
text_en: Enhancing host immunity through metabolites is highly regarded due to its environmental, low-cost, and nutritional characteristics.

quote: Likely, the dying fish and surviving fish upon bacterial infection represent different biological phenotypes, which can also be identified at the metabolomic level, and metabolites that distinguish the two phenotypes can be drawn, enabling the identification of metabolites in promoting fish survival.
statement: 感染细菌后死亡和存活的鱼类代表不同的生物表型，可通过代谢组学水平识别区分这两种表型的代谢物，从而鉴定出促进鱼类存活的代谢物。
text_zh: 感染细菌后死亡和存活的鱼类代表不同的生物表型，可通过代谢组学水平识别区分这两种表型的代谢物，从而鉴定出促进鱼类存活的代谢物。
text_en: Fish that died and survived after bacterial infection represent different biological phenotypes, which can be distinguished by metabolites identified at the metabolomics level, thereby identifying metabolites that promote fish survival.

quote: Therefore, our study established the metabolomic change of C. carassius during infection, and more importantly, the metabolomes of dying and survival fish can be separated.
statement: 本研究建立了感染期间鲤鲫的代谢组变化，并且能够区分濒死鱼和存活鱼的代谢组。
text_zh: 本研究建立了感染期间鲤鲫的代谢组变化，并且能够区分濒死鱼和存活鱼的代谢组。
text_en: This study established the metabolomic changes in common carp and crucian carp during infection, and was able to distinguish the metabolomes of dying fish from those of surviving fish.

quote: Our study suggested that metabolomic analysis not only can be diagnostic to bacterial infection but also sheds light on altering metabolic pathways that can be harnessed to enhance host survival.
statement: 研究认为代谢组学分析不仅可用于细菌感染的诊断，还能揭示可被利用以增强宿主存活的代谢通路改变。
text_zh: 研究认为代谢组学分析不仅可用于细菌感染的诊断，还能揭示可被利用以增强宿主存活的代谢通路改变。
text_en: The study suggests that metabolomics analysis can not only be used for the diagnosis of bacterial infections, but also reveal metabolic pathway changes that can be exploited to enhance host survival.

quote: In this study, for example, we proposed that the hyperactive pyruvate metabolism was correlated with fish death.
statement: 本研究中提出活跃的丙酮酸代谢与鱼类死亡相关。
text_zh: 本研究中提出活跃的丙酮酸代谢与鱼类死亡相关。
text_en: This study proposed that active pyruvate metabolism is associated with fish mortality.

quote: The metabolites, lactic acid, and fumaric acid were accumulated in dying fish.
statement: 乳酸和富马酸这两种代谢物在濒死鱼中积累。
text_zh: 乳酸和富马酸这两种代谢物在濒死鱼中积累。
text_en: The two metabolites, lactic acid and fumaric acid, accumulate in dying fish.

quote: Harnessing the host’s immune system has been an attractive strategy to prevent or treat bacterial infection (18).
statement: 利用宿主免疫系统是预防或治疗细菌感染的一种有吸引力的策略。
text_zh: 利用宿主免疫系统是预防或治疗细菌感染的一种有吸引力的策略。
text_en: Harnessing the host immune system is an attractive strategy for preventing or treating bacterial infections.

quote: Although vaccines have been proved to be one of the most successful approaches in preventing infectious diseases, the progress is still limited in aquaculture.
statement: 虽然疫苗已被证明是预防传染病最成功的方法之一，但在水产养殖中的进展仍然有限。
text_zh: 虽然疫苗已被证明是预防传染病最成功的方法之一，但在水产养殖中的进展仍然有限。
text_en: Although vaccines have been proven to be one of the most successful methods for preventing infectious diseases, progress in aquaculture remains limited.

quote: In China, for example, there are only 6 certified vaccines to be used in aquaculture (19), which dramatically lags the demand to treat various types of pathogens.
statement: 例如在中国，只有6种经认证的疫苗可用于水产养殖，这远远落后于治疗各种类型病原体的需求。
text_zh: 例如在中国，只有6种经认证的疫苗可用于水产养殖，这远远落后于治疗各种类型病原体的需求。
text_en: For example, in China, only 6 certified vaccines are available for aquaculture, which is far behind the demand for treating various types of pathogens.
outcome: 病原体治疗资源可用性

quote: Water temperature is an important factor in the growth, reproduction and survival of aquatic organisms.
statement: 水温是影响水生生物生长、繁殖和存活的重要因素。
text_zh: 水温是影响水生生物生长、繁殖和存活的重要因素。
text_en: Water temperature is an important factor affecting the growth, reproduction, and survival of aquatic organisms.

quote: Caudal fins were cut from three to five fish of each clonal line, batched in 1% sodium hypochloride solution for 1 min and then rinsed in 70% ethyl alcohol for 2 s.
statement: 从每个克隆系的三到五条鱼身上剪下尾鳍，在1%次氯酸钠溶液中浸泡1分钟，然后在70%乙醇中冲洗2秒。
text_zh: 从每个克隆系的三到五条鱼身上剪下尾鳍，在1%次氯酸钠溶液中浸泡1分钟，然后在70%乙醇中冲洗2秒。
text_en: Tail fins were clipped from three to five fish per clone line, soaked in 1% sodium hypochlorite solution for 1 minute, and then rinsed in 70% ethanol for 2 seconds.

quote: For serum complement activity, alternative complement serum activity was determined as previously described (50 , 51).
statement: 血清补体活性（替代途径）按照先前描述的方法进行测定。
text_zh: 血清补体活性（替代途径）按照先前描述的方法进行测定。
text_en: Serum complement activity (alternative pathway) was determined according to previously described methods.

quote: *No ﬁsh died withing 4 h.
statement: SCC-1克隆系在4小时内没有鱼死亡。
text_zh: SCC-1克隆系在4小时内没有鱼死亡。
text_en: No fish died within 4 hours in the SCC-1 clone line.

quote: Individual juvenile ﬁsh reared at 20°C were exposed to thermal stress at 36.5 ± 0.5°C and their death times during this exposure were measured.
statement: 在20°C饲养的个体幼鱼暴露于36.5 ± 0.5°C的热应激下，并测量其在此期间的死亡时间。
text_zh: 在20°C饲养的个体幼鱼暴露于36.5 ± 0.5°C的热应激下，并测量其在此期间的死亡时间。
text_en: Individual juvenile fish reared at 20°C were exposed to heat stress at 36.5 ± 0.5°C, and their time of death during this period was measured.

quote: The death times of SCC-2 and SCC-3 ﬁsh were 66.6 ± 31.2 and 144.7 ± 49.8 min, respectively. In con- trast, all SCC-1 ﬁsh survived under these conditions.
statement: SCC-2和SCC-3鱼的死亡时间分别为66.6 ± 31.2分钟和144.7 ± 49.8分钟，而所有SCC-1鱼在这些条件下均存活。
text_zh: SCC-2和SCC-3鱼的死亡时间分别为66.6 ± 31.2分钟和144.7 ± 49.8分钟，而所有SCC-1鱼在这些条件下均存活。
text_en: The death times of SCC-2 and SCC-3 fish were 66.6 ± 31.2 minutes and 144.7 ± 49.8 minutes, respectively, while all SCC-1 fish survived under these conditions.

quote: After crucian carp were infected with A. salmonicida , the gene and protein expression of C-type lysozymes in the liver, spleen, kidney, and hindgut were significantly upregulated, with the liver showing the highest upregulation that was 15 times higher than that in the uninfected group.
statement: 鲫鱼感染杀鲑气单胞菌后，肝脏、脾脏、肾脏和后肠中C型溶菌酶的基因和蛋白表达显著上调，其中肝脏的上调幅度最高，比未感染组高15倍。
text_zh: 鲫鱼感染杀鲑气单胞菌后，肝脏、脾脏、肾脏和后肠中C型溶菌酶的基因和蛋白表达显著上调，其中肝脏的上调幅度最高，比未感染组高15倍。
text_en: After Carassius auratus was infected with Aeromonas salmonicida, the gene and protein expression of C-type lysozyme in the liver, spleen, kidney, and hindgut were significantly upregulated, with the highest upregulation in the liver, which was 15 times higher than that in the uninfected group.
outcome: 疾病应激下的免疫响应

quote: In addition, recombinant C-type lysozyme exhibited significant antibacterial activity against A. salmonicida , with an average inhibition zone radius of 0.92 cm when using 40 μg recombinant lysozyme.
statement: 此外，重组C型溶菌酶对杀鲑气单胞菌表现出显著的抗菌活性，使用40微克重组溶菌酶时平均抑菌圈半径为0.92厘米。
text_zh: 此外，重组C型溶菌酶对杀鲑气单胞菌表现出显著的抗菌活性，使用40微克重组溶菌酶时平均抑菌圈半径为0.92厘米。
text_en: In addition, recombinant C-type lysozyme showed significant antibacterial activity against Aeromonas salmonicida, with an average inhibition zone radius of 0.92 cm when using 40 micrograms of recombinant lysozyme.

quote: survival rates of the three clonal lines after the high-temperature treatment. The survival rate of SCC-1, with no ﬁsh dying within 4 h, was the highest of the three lines.
statement: 高温处理后，SCC-1克隆系的存活率最高，在4小时内没有鱼死亡。
text_zh: 高温处理后，SCC-1克隆系的存活率最高，在4小时内没有鱼死亡。
text_en: After high-temperature treatment, the survival rate of the SCC-1 clone was the highest, with no fish deaths within 4 hours.

quote: As shown in Table 1, the mean death times of SCC-2 and SCC-3 were 66.6 ± 31.2 and 144.7 ± 49.8 min, respectively.
statement: SCC-2和SCC-3克隆系在高温处理后的平均死亡时间分别为66.6±31.2分钟和144.7±49.8分钟。
text_zh: SCC-2和SCC-3克隆系在高温处理后的平均死亡时间分别为66.6±31.2分钟和144.7±49.8分钟。
text_en: The average death times of the SCC-2 and SCC-3 clones after high temperature treatment were 66.6±31.2 minutes and 144.7±49.8 minutes, respectively.

quote: Fish were reared in a 60 L recirculating tank at a temperature of 20°C.
statement: 鱼在20°C的60升循环水箱中饲养。
text_zh: 鱼在20°C的60升循环水箱中饲养。
text_en: Fish were reared in a 60-liter recirculating tank at 20°C.

quote: Each clonal ﬁsh line was maintained separately in an individual cage at a density of 30 ﬁsh per cage (22 ¥ 10 ¥ 8 cm).
statement: 每个克隆品系单独饲养在一个网箱中，密度为每箱30尾。
text_zh: 每个克隆品系单独饲养在一个网箱中，密度为每箱30尾。
text_en: Each clone line was reared separately in a net cage at a density of 30 fish per cage.

quote: Fish were fed ad libitum three times daily on pellet feed and a supplement of red worm (Chironomid larvae).
statement: 鱼每天自由摄食三次，饲料为颗粒饲料并补充红虫（摇蚊幼虫）。
text_zh: 鱼每天自由摄食三次，饲料为颗粒饲料并补充红虫（摇蚊幼虫）。
text_en: Fish were fed ad libitum three times daily, with pellet feed supplemented with bloodworms (chironomid larvae).

quote: Fifteen ﬁsh (60–65 days after hatching) were selected from each clonal line in a random fashion and were held in a mesh cage (20 ¥ 10 ¥ 10 cm; one cage per clonal line) placed in an aquarium regu-lated at a temperature of 36.5 ± 0.5°C.
statement: 从每个克隆品系随机选取15尾鱼放入置于36.5±0.5°C水族箱中的网箱内进行高温耐受性测试。
text_zh: 从每个克隆品系随机选取15尾鱼放入置于36.5±0.5°C水族箱中的网箱内进行高温耐受性测试。

quote: The rearing water was mixed by aeration and oxygen was sup-plied to the aquarium.
statement: 养殖水通过曝气混合并向水族箱供氧。
text_zh: 养殖水通过曝气混合并向水族箱供氧。
text_en: Aquaculture water is aerated, mixed, and supplied with oxygen to the aquarium.

quote: Fish weighing approximately 180 g were transferred into a 1000-L aerated water tank and cultured at 20–22 °C for 7 d.
statement: 鲫鱼被转移到充气的1000升水箱中，在20-22°C条件下养殖7天。
text_zh: 鲫鱼被转移到充气的1000升水箱中，在20-22°C条件下养殖7天。
text_en: Crucian carp were transferred to aerated 1000-liter tanks and reared for 7 days at 20-22°C.

quote: During the experiment, two-thirds of the water was replaced every 2 d.
statement: 实验期间，每2天更换三分之二的水。
text_zh: 实验期间，每2天更换三分之二的水。
text_en: During the experiment, two-thirds of the water was changed every 2 days.

quote: The fish were fed pelletized feed daily at 2–3% of their body weight.
statement: 鱼每天按体重的2-3%投喂颗粒饲料。
text_zh: 鱼每天按体重的2-3%投喂颗粒饲料。
text_en: Fish are fed pellet feed at 2-3% of body weight daily.

quote: The experimental group was intra-abdominally injected with 0.2 mL of 1.5 × 10 8 CFU/mL bacterial suspension; the control group was intra-abdominally injected with 0.2 mL of sterile PBS.
statement: 实验组腹腔注射0.2毫升浓度为1.5×10^8 CFU/mL的细菌悬液，对照组腹腔注射0.2毫升无菌PBS。
text_zh: 实验组腹腔注射0.2毫升浓度为1.5×10^8 CFU/mL的细菌悬液，对照组腹腔注射0.2毫升无菌PBS。
text_en: The experimental group was intraperitoneally injected with 0.2 mL of a bacterial suspension at a concentration of 1.5×10^8 CFU/mL, and the control group was intraperitoneally injected with 0.2 mL of sterile PBS.

quote: Fish were anesthetized by immersion in 100 ng/mL MS-222, and their liver, kidney, spleen, and posterior intestinal tissues were dissected by opening the abdomen.
statement: 鱼通过浸入100 ng/mL的MS-222进行麻醉，并通过打开腹部解剖其肝脏、肾脏、脾脏和后肠组织。
text_zh: 鱼通过浸入100 ng/mL的MS-222进行麻醉，并通过打开腹部解剖其肝脏、肾脏、脾脏和后肠组织。
text_en: Fish were anesthetized by immersion in 100 ng/mL MS-222, and liver, kidney, spleen, and hindgut tissues were dissected by opening the abdomen.
outcome: 屠宰/取样前的应激控制

quote: In recent years, high-density and intensive farming practices and the excessive use of antibiotics have led to a high incidence of disease in crucian carp.
statement: 高密度集约化养殖和抗生素的过度使用导致鲫鱼疾病高发。
text_zh: 高密度集约化养殖和抗生素的过度使用导致鲫鱼疾病高发。
text_en: High-density intensive farming and excessive use of antibiotics lead to a high incidence of disease in crucian carp.
intervention_record: 高密度集约化与抗生素过度使用

quote: Aeromonas salmonicida is a pathogen that causes fish furunculosis, which causes significant economic losses to the global aquaculture industry.
statement: 杀鲑气单胞菌是引起鱼疖疮病的病原体，给全球水产养殖业造成重大经济损失。
text_zh: 杀鲑气单胞菌是引起鱼疖疮病的病原体，给全球水产养殖业造成重大经济损失。
text_en: Aeromonas salmonicida is the pathogen that causes fish furunculosis, causing significant economic losses to the global aquaculture industry.

quote: In recent years, there have also been reports of A. salmonicida infecting crucian carp [ 2 , 3 ].
statement: 近年来也有报道杀鲑气单胞菌感染鲫鱼。
text_zh: 近年来也有报道杀鲑气单胞菌感染鲫鱼。
text_en: In recent years, there have also been reports of Aeromonas salmonicida infection in crucian carp.

quote: Among them, upregulation in the liver was the most significant, i.e., 15 times higher than that before infection (p (Fig. 4 A).
statement: 其中，肝脏中的上调最为显著，即比感染前高15倍。
text_zh: 其中，肝脏中的上调最为显著，即比感染前高15倍。
text_en: Among them, the upregulation in the liver was most significant, being 15 times higher than before infection.
outcome: 疾病应激下的免疫反应

quote: Lysozyme, an innate immune defense factor, is crucial in protecting aquatic animals against microbial infections [ 6 , 7 ].
statement: 溶菌酶作为一种先天免疫防御因子，在保护水生动物免受微生物感染方面至关重要。
text_zh: 溶菌酶作为一种先天免疫防御因子，在保护水生动物免受微生物感染方面至关重要。
text_en: Lysozyme, as an innate immune defense factor, is crucial in protecting aquatic animals from microbial infections.

quote: The results of the in vitro bacteriostatic tests showed that the recombinant C-type lysozyme exhibited significant bacteriostatic activity against A. salmonicida .
statement: 体外抑菌试验结果显示，重组C型溶菌酶对杀鲑气单胞菌表现出显著的抑菌活性。
text_zh: 体外抑菌试验结果显示，重组C型溶菌酶对杀鲑气单胞菌表现出显著的抑菌活性。
text_en: In vitro antibacterial test results showed that recombinant C-type lysozyme exhibited significant antibacterial activity against Aeromonas salmonicida.

quote: Carrageenan oligosaccharide prepared in Section 2.5 was supplemented to the diet in four groups, namely, 0.1%, 0.2%, 0.5% and 1% (w / w).
statement: 卡拉胶寡糖以四种浓度（0.1%、0.2%、0.5%和1%，w/w）添加到饲料中。
text_zh: 卡拉胶寡糖以四种浓度（0.1%、0.2%、0.5%和1%，w/w）添加到饲料中。
text_en: Carrageenan oligosaccharides were added to the feed at four concentrations (0.1%, 0.2%, 0.5%, and 1%, w/w).

quote: After a 6-month feeding trial, the SR (Survival Ratio) was significantly higher in fish fed 0.1% (Diet 1), 0.2% (Diet 2), 0.5% (Diet 3) and 1% (Diet 4) COS diets than that in the control group
statement: 在为期6个月的饲养试验后，喂食含0.1%、0.2%、0.5%和1%壳寡糖（COS）饲料的鱼其存活率显著高于对照组。
text_zh: 在为期6个月的饲养试验后，喂食含0.1%、0.2%、0.5%和1%壳寡糖（COS）饲料的鱼其存活率显著高于对照组。
text_en: After a 6-month feeding trial, the survival rate of fish fed diets containing 0.1%, 0.2%, 0.5%, and 1% chitosan oligosaccharide (COS) was significantly higher than that of the control group.

quote: The addition of COSs did not improve the growth performance of crucian carp, which may be related to the size of the fish, water temperature, dissolved oxygen and living environment.
statement: 添加壳寡糖并未改善鲫鱼的生长性能，这可能与鱼的大小、水温、溶解氧和生活环境有关。
text_zh: 添加壳寡糖并未改善鲫鱼的生长性能，这可能与鱼的大小、水温、溶解氧和生活环境有关。
text_en: Adding chitosan oligosaccharide did not improve the growth performance of crucian carp, which may be related to fish size, water temperature, dissolved oxygen, and living environment.

quote: Herein, the dietary effects of COSs on the growth performance and non-specific immunity of crucian carp were investigated.
statement: 本研究调查了卡拉胶寡糖（COSs）的膳食效果对鲫鱼生长性能和非特异性免疫的影响。
text_zh: 本研究调查了卡拉胶寡糖（COSs）的膳食效果对鲫鱼生长性能和非特异性免疫的影响。
text_en: This study investigated the dietary effects of carrageenan oligosaccharides (COSs) on the growth performance and non-specific immunity of crucian carp.
outcome: 生长性能与非特异性免疫

quote: The growth performance, such as survival percent, the serum index, including serum total protein (TP), serum total cholesterol (CHO), serum high-density lipoprotein cholesterol (HDL-C) and serum total triacylglycerol (TG) were evaluated.
statement: 评估了包括存活率在内的生长性能，以及血清总蛋白、血清总胆固醇、高密度脂蛋白胆固醇和血清总甘油三酯等血清指标。
text_zh: 评估了包括存活率在内的生长性能，以及血清总蛋白、血清总胆固醇、高密度脂蛋白胆固醇和血清总甘油三酯等血清指标。
text_en: Growth performance, including survival rate, and serum parameters such as total serum protein, total serum cholesterol, high-density lipoprotein cholesterol, and total serum triglycerides were evaluated.
outcome: 存活率与血清生化指标

quote: In addition, the non-specific immunity factors such as superoxide dismutase (SOD), catalase (CAT) and serum malondialdehyde (MDA), lysozyme (LYM) have also been investigated.
statement: 此外，还研究了超氧化物歧化酶、过氧化氢酶、血清丙二醛和溶菌酶等非特异性免疫因子。
text_zh: 此外，还研究了超氧化物歧化酶、过氧化氢酶、血清丙二醛和溶菌酶等非特异性免疫因子。
text_en: In addition, non-specific immune factors such as superoxide dismutase, catalase, serum malondialdehyde, and lysozyme were also studied.
outcome: 非特异性免疫因子水平

quote: Dietary supplementation of COSs decreased the MDA content in the serum (Figure 6 A), and increased the activity of LZM, SOD and CAT (Figure 6 B–D).
statement: 膳食补充壳寡糖（COSs）降低了血清中的MDA含量，并提高了LZM、SOD和CAT的活性。
text_zh: 膳食补充壳寡糖（COSs）降低了血清中的MDA含量，并提高了LZM、SOD和CAT的活性。
text_en: Dietary supplementation with chitooligosaccharides (COSs) reduced serum MDA content and increased the activities of LZM, SOD, and CAT.
outcome: 免疫参数与抗氧化能力

quote: The LZM activity was increased with the increasing dietary COSs supplemented, with the highest activity in the Diet 4 group, which is contrary to the MDA content.
statement: 随着膳食中壳寡糖添加量的增加，溶菌酶（LZM）活性升高，在Diet 4组达到最高，这与MDA含量的变化趋势相反。
text_zh: 随着膳食中壳寡糖添加量的增加，溶菌酶（LZM）活性升高，在Diet 4组达到最高，这与MDA含量的变化趋势相反。
text_en: As the dietary chitosan oligosaccharide supplementation level increased, lysozyme (LZM) activity rose, reaching its highest value in the Diet 4 group, which was opposite to the trend of MDA content.

quote: The highest LZM activity and lowest MDA content were both found in the plasma of fish with Diet 4 diet, which was significantly different from the control group
statement: Diet 4组鱼血浆中观察到最高的LZM活性和最低的MDA含量，且与对照组相比差异显著。
text_zh: Diet 4组鱼血浆中观察到最高的LZM活性和最低的MDA含量，且与对照组相比差异显著。
text_en: The highest LZM activity and the lowest MDA content were observed in the plasma of fish in Diet 4 group, with significant differences compared to the control group.

quote: Herein, we aimed to efficiently prepare the COSs by using a novel carrageenase CgkA from Zobellia uliginosa with high activity and further investigate the effects of dietary supplementation with COSs on the growth performance, serum biochemical parameters and non-specific immunity in Carassius auratus gibelio.
statement: 本研究旨在利用来自 Zobellia uliginosa 的新型卡拉胶酶 CgkA 高效制备卡拉胶寡糖（COSs），并进一步探究膳食补充 COSs 对鲫鱼生长性能、血清生化参数和非特异性免疫的影响。
text_zh: 本研究旨在利用来自 Zobellia uliginosa 的新型卡拉胶酶 CgkA 高效制备卡拉胶寡糖（COSs），并进一步探究膳食补充 COSs 对鲫鱼生长性能、血清生化参数和非特异性免疫的影响。
text_en: This study aims to efficiently prepare carrageenan oligosaccharides (COSs) using a novel kappa-carrageenase CgkA from Zobellia uliginosa, and further investigate the effects of dietary supplementation with COSs on growth performance, serum biochemical parameters, and non-specific immunity in crucian carp.
outcome: 生长性能、血清生化指标及非特异性免疫

quote: The results indicated that the CgkA could effectively degrade the carrageenan into oligosaccharides with DPs of 2–6 and the oligosaccharides exhibited promoting effects on growth performance, serum biochemical index and non-specific immune parameters.
statement: 结果表明，CgkA 能有效将卡拉胶降解为聚合度为 2-6 的寡糖，且这些寡糖对生长性能、血清生化指数和非特异性免疫参数表现出促进作用。
text_zh: 结果表明，CgkA 能有效将卡拉胶降解为聚合度为 2-6 的寡糖，且这些寡糖对生长性能、血清生化指数和非特异性免疫参数表现出促进作用。
text_en: The results showed that CgkA effectively degraded carrageenan into oligosaccharides with a degree of polymerization of 2-6, and these oligosaccharides exhibited promoting effects on growth performance, serum biochemical indices, and non-specific immune parameters.
outcome: 生长性能、血清生化指标及非特异性免疫

quote: After a 6-month feeding trial, the SR (Survival Ratio) was significantly higher in fish fed 0.1% (Diet 1), 0.2% (Diet 2), 0.5% (Diet 3) and 1% (Diet 4) COSs diets than that in the control group (p < 0.05).
statement: 经过6个月的喂养试验，饲喂含0.1%至1%卡拉胶寡糖饲料的鱼组存活率显著高于对照组。
text_zh: 经过6个月的喂养试验，饲喂含0.1%至1%卡拉胶寡糖饲料的鱼组存活率显著高于对照组。
text_en: After a 6-month feeding trial, the survival rate of fish fed diets containing 0.1% to 1% carrageenan oligosaccharides was significantly higher than that of the control group.

quote: Li et al. reported that the addition of mannan oligosaccharides to feed could significantly increase the activities of SOD and LZM in the serum of tilapia [ 53 ].
statement: 在饲料中添加甘露寡糖可显著增加罗非鱼血清中SOD和LZM的活性。
text_zh: 在饲料中添加甘露寡糖可显著增加罗非鱼血清中SOD和LZM的活性。
text_en: Adding mannan oligosaccharides to feed can significantly increase the activity of SOD and LZM in the serum of tilapia.
outcome: 非特异性免疫指标（SOD、LZM活性）

quote: Lin et al. found that a supplement of chitin oligosaccharides in the feed could effectively improve the activity of LZM in the serum of carp [ 54 ].
statement: 在饲料中补充几丁质寡糖可有效提高鲤鱼血清中LZM的活性。
text_zh: 在饲料中补充几丁质寡糖可有效提高鲤鱼血清中LZM的活性。
text_en: Supplementing chitooligosaccharides in feed can effectively increase the activity of LZM in carp serum.
outcome: 非特异性免疫指标（LZM活性）

quote: Yu et al. discovered that the addition of 0.2–0.3% konjac mannan oligosaccharides to the diet can significantly increase the activities of SOD and LZM in the serum of Pseudobagrus fulvidraco [ 55 ].
statement: 在日粮中添加0.2–0.3%魔芋葡甘聚糖寡糖可显著增加黄颡鱼血清中SOD和LZM的活性。
text_zh: 在日粮中添加0.2–0.3%魔芋葡甘聚糖寡糖可显著增加黄颡鱼血清中SOD和LZM的活性。
text_en: Adding 0.2–0.3% konjac glucomannan oligosaccharide to the diet significantly increased the activity of SOD and LZM in the serum of yellow catfish.
outcome: 非特异性免疫指标（SOD、LZM活性）

quote: As shown in Figure 6 , the activities of serum SOD, LZM and CAT displayed a significant dose relationship with the concentration of COSs, and the activities reached the maximum value when the oligosaccharide supplemental level was 1%, which was significantly (p These results indicate that carrageenan oligosaccharides as a feed additive can significantly improve the non-specific immunity of experimental fish, which is consistent with the increasing survival rate of Carassius auratus during feeding.
statement: 血清SOD、LZM和CAT活性与卡拉胶寡糖浓度呈显著剂量关系，且在1%添加量时达到最大值，表明卡拉胶寡糖作为饲料添加剂能显著提高实验鱼的非特异性免疫力，这与鲫鱼存活率的增加一致。
text_zh: 血清SOD、LZM和CAT活性与卡拉胶寡糖浓度呈显著剂量关系，且在1%添加量时达到最大值，表明卡拉胶寡糖作为饲料添加剂能显著提高实验鱼的非特异性免疫力，这与鲫鱼存活率的增加一致。
text_en: Serum SOD, LZM and CAT activities showed a significant dose-response relationship with carrageenan oligosaccharide concentration, reaching maximum values at a 1% inclusion level, indicating that carrageenan oligosaccharides as feed additives can significantly improve the non-specific immunity of experimental fish, which is consistent with the increase in crucian carp survival rate.
outcome: 非特异性免疫及存活率

quote: Considering the cost of preparation of COS on a large scale, it is still challenging to realize the applications of COS as an additive in fodder for fresh fish.
statement: 由于大规模制备壳寡糖（COS）的成本问题，将其作为鲜鱼饲料添加剂的应用仍具有挑战性。
text_zh: 由于大规模制备壳寡糖（COS）的成本问题，将其作为鲜鱼饲料添加剂的应用仍具有挑战性。
text_en: Due to the cost issues of large-scale preparation of chitosan oligosaccharides (COS), its application as a feed additive for fresh fish remains challenging.

quote: This is the common drawback of developing novel natural and green additives in aquaculture.
statement: 这是在水产养殖中开发新型天然和绿色添加剂的常见缺点。
text_zh: 这是在水产养殖中开发新型天然和绿色添加剂的常见缺点。
text_en: This is a common drawback in developing novel natural and green additives in aquaculture.
outcome: 添加剂开发的普遍局限性

quote: Liu et al. added different concentrations of fructooligosaccharides into the feed of hybrid tilapia, and the results showed that there was no significant difference in weight gain rate and feed conversion rate among the different groups
statement: 在杂交罗非鱼饲料中添加不同浓度的低聚果糖，各组间的增重率和饲料转化率无显著差异。
text_zh: 在杂交罗非鱼饲料中添加不同浓度的低聚果糖，各组间的增重率和饲料转化率无显著差异。
text_en: Adding different concentrations of fructooligosaccharides to the feed of hybrid tilapia resulted in no significant difference in weight gain rate and feed conversion ratio between groups.

quote: Qin et al. reported that dietary chitosan oligosaccharides had no significant effects on mortality, feed conversion rate and weight gain rate of hybrid tilapia
statement: 日粮中的壳寡糖对杂交罗非鱼的死亡率、饲料转化率和增重率没有显著影响。
text_zh: 日粮中的壳寡糖对杂交罗非鱼的死亡率、饲料转化率和增重率没有显著影响。
text_en: Chitosan oligosaccharide in the diet had no significant effect on mortality, feed conversion ratio, and weight gain rate of hybrid tilapia.

quote: Razeghi et al. found that there was no significant difference in growth performance parameters between the blank control group and the experimental group after mannan oligosaccharides were added to sturgeon feed
statement: 在鲟鱼饲料中添加甘露寡糖后，空白对照组和实验组之间的生长性能参数没有显著差异。
text_zh: 在鲟鱼饲料中添加甘露寡糖后，空白对照组和实验组之间的生长性能参数没有显著差异。
text_en: There was no significant difference in growth performance parameters between the blank control group and the experimental group after adding mannan oligosaccharides to sturgeon feed.

quote: Zhang et al. found that dietary chitin oligosaccharides supplementation of 0.6% and 0.8% displayed a significant promotion effect on the weight gain rate of juvenile sea bass, but supplementation at 0.2%, 0.4% and 1.0% exhibited an inhibitory effect on the weight gain rate
statement: 日粮中补充0.6%和0.8%的几丁质寡糖显著促进了幼鱼鲈鱼的增重率，但补充0.2%、0.4%和1.0%则抑制了增重率。
text_zh: 日粮中补充0.6%和0.8%的几丁质寡糖显著促进了幼鱼鲈鱼的增重率，但补充0.2%、0.4%和1.0%则抑制了增重率。
text_en: Dietary supplementation with 0.6% and 0.8% chitooligosaccharides significantly promoted the weight gain rate of juvenile sea bass, but supplementation with 0.2%, 0.4%, and 1.0% inhibited the weight gain rate.
counterevidence: 高浓度和低浓度添加产生抑制效果

quote: The reasons for the above phenomena may be related to the basic diet of fish, animal characteristics, feeding time and feeding environment
statement: 上述现象的原因可能与鱼类的基础日粮、动物特性、喂养时间和喂养环境有关。
text_zh: 上述现象的原因可能与鱼类的基础日粮、动物特性、喂养时间和喂养环境有关。
text_en: The causes of the above phenomena may be related to the basal diet of fish, animal characteristics, feeding time, and feeding environment.

quote: In addition, the supplement of COSs decreased the malondialdehyde (MDA) content in the serum and increased the activity of lysozyme (LZM), superoxide dismutase (SOD) and catalase (CAT).
statement: 补充卡拉胶寡糖降低了血清中的丙二醛含量，并增加了溶菌酶、超氧化物歧化酶和过氧化氢酶的活性。
text_zh: 补充卡拉胶寡糖降低了血清中的丙二醛含量，并增加了溶菌酶、超氧化物歧化酶和过氧化氢酶的活性。
text_en: Supplementing carrageenan oligosaccharides reduced the malondialdehyde content in serum and increased the activities of lysozyme, superoxide dismutase, and catalase.
outcome: 氧化应激与免疫酶活性

quote: Due to the serious problem of bacterial resistance caused by traditional antibiotic therapies, developing new antimicrobial methods is imperative
statement: 传统抗生素疗法导致的细菌耐药性问题严重，因此开发新的抗菌方法是必要的。
text_zh: 传统抗生素疗法导致的细菌耐药性问题严重，因此开发新的抗菌方法是必要的。
text_en: The bacterial resistance problem caused by traditional antibiotic therapy is severe, therefore developing new antimicrobial methods is necessary.
outcome: 疾病控制与抗生素耐药性

quote: This demonstrated that recombinant C-type lysozyme from crucian carp can effectively inhibit the proliferation of A. salmonicida in vitro.
statement: 这表明来自鲫鱼的重组C型溶菌酶可以在体外有效抑制杀鲑气单胞菌的增殖。
text_zh: 这表明来自鲫鱼的重组C型溶菌酶可以在体外有效抑制杀鲑气单胞菌的增殖。
text_en: This indicates that recombinant type C lysozyme from crucian carp can effectively inhibit the proliferation of Aeromonas salmonicida in vitro.

quote: The water was filtered through coral sand, and oxygen was provided by a low-pressure blower.
statement: 养殖水经过珊瑚砂过滤，并通过低压鼓风机供氧。
text_zh: 养殖水经过珊瑚砂过滤，并通过低压鼓风机供氧。
text_en: Aquaculture water is filtered through coral sand and oxygenated by low-pressure blowers.
intervention: Coral sand filtration and blower aeration
intervention_record: 珊瑚砂过滤与鼓风曝气

quote: During the feeding trial, fish were fed a diet at 5% of body weight twice per day (8:00 and 18:00, respectively), and the feeding amount was slightly changed every two weeks according to the growth of fish and feed intake.
statement: 试验期间每天两次按体重的5%投喂饲料，并根据鱼的生长和摄食量每两周微调投喂量。
text_zh: 试验期间每天两次按体重的5%投喂饲料，并根据鱼的生长和摄食量每两周微调投喂量。
text_en: During the experimental period, feed was provided twice daily at 5% of body weight, and the feeding amount was fine-tuned every two weeks based on fish growth and food intake.

quote: The temperature and pH of the rearing water were kept at 20 ± 2 °C and pH 7.5 ± 0.5, respectively.
statement: 养殖水的温度控制在20±2°C，pH值控制在7.5±0.5。
text_zh: 养殖水的温度控制在20±2°C，pH值控制在7.5±0.5。
text_en: The temperature of the aquaculture water was controlled at 20±2°C, and the pH value was controlled at 7.5±0.5.

quote: The dissolved oxygen was more than 5.0 mg/L.
statement: 溶解氧保持在5.0 mg/L以上。
text_zh: 溶解氧保持在5.0 mg/L以上。
text_en: Dissolved oxygen is maintained above 5.0 mg/L.

quote: The ammonia nitrogen was lower than 0.01 mg/L
statement: 氨氮浓度低于0.01 mg/L。
text_zh: 氨氮浓度低于0.01 mg/L。
text_en: Ammonia nitrogen concentration is below 0.01 mg/L.

quote: The determination of superoxide dismutase (SOD), lysozyme (LZM) and malondialdehyde (MDA) was referred to the method described by Zhang et al. [ 57 ]. All the parameters were analyzed by following the protocols of the kits (Nanjing Jiancheng Bioengineering Institute, Nanjing, China).
statement: 超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）、溶菌酶（LZM）和丙二醛（MDA）的测定参考了Zhang等人描述的方法，并遵循南京建成生物工程研究所试剂盒的操作规程进行分析。
text_zh: 超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）、溶菌酶（LZM）和丙二醛（MDA）的测定参考了Zhang等人描述的方法，并遵循南京建成生物工程研究所试剂盒的操作规程进行分析。
text_en: The determination of superoxide dismutase (SOD), lysozyme (LZM), and malondialdehyde (MDA) referenced the methods described by Zhang et al. and was analyzed following the operating procedures of the kits from Nanjing Jiancheng Bioengineering Institute.
intervention_record: 非特异性免疫参数测定

quote: Persiapan sarana penelitian adalah persiapan akuarium berupa pengisian air dengan volume air sebanyak 20 liter dan dilakukan pemberian aerasi selama 24 jam sebelum digunakan. Tujuan dari persiapan akuarium adalah agar ikan yang dimasukkan tidak stres.
statement: Persiapan akuarium dengan aerasi selama 24 jam bertujuan untuk mencegah stres pada ikan saat dimasukkan.
text_en: Persiapan akuarium dengan aerasi selama 24 jam bertujuan untuk mencegah stres pada ikan saat dimasukkan.

quote: The CHO and TG in the control group were the highest and exhibited a decreasing trend with the increase in dietary oligosaccharide concentration, but there was no significant difference between Diet 3 and Diet 4 groups (p > 0.05).
statement: 对照组血清总胆固醇和甘油三酯含量最高，随着日粮中寡聚糖浓度的增加呈下降趋势，但Diet 3组和Diet 4组之间无显著差异。
text_zh: 对照组血清总胆固醇和甘油三酯含量最高，随着日粮中寡聚糖浓度的增加呈下降趋势，但Diet 3组和Diet 4组之间无显著差异。
text_en: The serum total cholesterol and triglyceride contents were highest in the control group, showing a decreasing trend with increasing carrageenan oligosaccharide concentration in the diet, but there was no significant difference between Diet 3 and Diet 4.

quote: The level of TP reflected the immune stress state of the fish, and the TP content of fish in the state of disease will decrease [ 46 ].
statement: 总蛋白水平反映了鱼的免疫应激状态，患病状态下鱼的总蛋白含量会降低。
text_zh: 总蛋白水平反映了鱼的免疫应激状态，患病状态下鱼的总蛋白含量会降低。
text_en: Total protein levels reflect the immune stress status of fish; total protein content decreases in diseased fish.

quote: Herein, the TP content of the Diet 4 group was significantly (p 47 ]. The addition of COSs significantly decreased the content of CHO and TG in the serum and significantly increased the content of HDL-C in the serum.
statement: 在此研究中，Diet 4组的总蛋白含量显著（原文截断）。添加壳寡糖显著降低了血清中的总胆固醇和甘油三酯含量，并显著增加了血清中的高密度脂蛋白胆固醇含量。
text_zh: 在此研究中，Diet 4组的总蛋白含量显著（原文截断）。添加壳寡糖显著降低了血清中的总胆固醇和甘油三酯含量，并显著增加了血清中的高密度脂蛋白胆固醇含量。
text_en: In this study, the total protein content of Diet 4 group was significantly (original text truncated). The addition of chitosan oligosaccharide significantly reduced serum total cholesterol and triglyceride levels, and significantly increased serum high-density lipoprotein cholesterol levels.

quote: Manfaat yang diharapkan dari penelitian ini adalah dengan mengetahui jenis bakteri gram negatif apa saja yang sering ditemukan pada ikan Maskoki (Carassius auratus) akibat infestasi yang disebabkan oleh ektoparasit Argulus sp., sehingga dapat memberikan informasi dan manfaat bagi para pelaku budidaya ikan untuk menanggulangi serangan ektoparasit Argulus sp.
statement: Hasil identifikasi bakteri gram negatif diharapkan dapat membantu pelaku budidaya dalam menanggulangi serangan ektoparasit Argulus sp. pada ikan Maskoki.
text_en: Hasil identifikasi bakteri gram negatif diharapkan dapat membantu pelaku budidaya dalam menanggulangi serangan ektoparasit Argulus sp. pada ikan Maskoki.

quote: a natural photoperiod (12/12-h day/night) was used during the trial.
statement: 试验期间使用自然光周期（12小时白天/12小时黑夜）。
text_zh: 试验期间使用自然光周期（12小时白天/12小时黑夜）。
text_en: A natural photoperiod (12 hours light/12 hours dark) was used during the trial period.

quote: The uneaten diet was aspirated by siphoning manually after 40 min of feeding and dried to record the feed intake.
statement: 投喂40分钟后，通过人工虹吸方式吸出未食用的饲料并干燥以记录摄食量。
text_zh: 投喂40分钟后，通过人工虹吸方式吸出未食用的饲料并干燥以记录摄食量。
text_en: After feeding for 40 minutes, uneaten feed was siphoned out manually and dried to record the feed intake.

quote: One-third of the water in each tank was replaced every three days with tap water.
statement: 每三天用自来水更换每个水箱中三分之一的水。
text_zh: 每三天用自来水更换每个水箱中三分之一的水。
text_en: One-third of the water in each tank was replaced with tap water every three days.

quote: all fish need to be fasted for 24 h before sampling.
statement: 采样前所有鱼需禁食24小时。
text_zh: 采样前所有鱼需禁食24小时。
text_en: All fish must be fasted for 24 hours before sampling.

quote: Ten more fish were randomly taken from each tank and anesthetized with MS-222 (Sigma, St Louis, MO, USA) to measure the body weight and standard length, and blood samples were collected with heparinized syringes, respectively.
statement: 从每个水箱随机取十条鱼，用MS-222麻醉后测量体重和标准体长，并分别用肝素化注射器采集血液样本。
text_zh: 从每个水箱随机取十条鱼，用MS-222麻醉后测量体重和标准体长，并分别用肝素化注射器采集血液样本。
text_en: Ten fish were randomly sampled from each tank, anesthetized with MS-222, and measured for body weight and standard length; blood samples were collected using heparinized syringes.

quote: Recently, the rapid development and wide applications of the intensification farming model have caused the spread of bacterial diseases, which have resulted in high economic losses and greatly restricted the development of the green aquacultural farming model
statement: 集约化养殖模式的快速发展导致了细菌性疾病的传播。
text_zh: 集约化养殖模式的快速发展导致了细菌性疾病的传播。
text_en: The rapid development of intensive farming models has led to the spread of bacterial diseases.

quote: However, the prolonged overuse of antibiotics has resulted in drug resistance and drug residue contamination
statement: 抗生素的长期过度使用导致了耐药性和药物残留污染。
text_zh: 抗生素的长期过度使用导致了耐药性和药物残留污染。
text_en: The long-term overuse of antibiotics has led to resistance and drug residue pollution.

quote: Hasil penelitian ini didapatkan tiga bakteri antara lain yaitu : Aeromonas hydrophilla, Pseudomonas flourescens, Flexibacter columnaris sedangkan untuk Edwardsiella tarda tidak ditemukan pada identifikasi bakteri.
statement: Penelitian ini menemukan tiga jenis bakteri (Aeromonas hydrophilla, Pseudomonas flourescens, Flexibacter columnaris) namun tidak menemukan Edwardsiella tarda.
text_en: Penelitian ini menemukan tiga jenis bakteri (Aeromonas hydrophilla, Pseudomonas flourescens, Flexibacter columnaris) namun tidak menemukan Edwardsiella tarda.

quote: Effects of dietary mannan oligosaccharides (MOS) supplementation on metabolism, inflammatory response and gut microbiota of juvenile Nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) fed with high carbohydrate diet.

quote: In the two experimental groups (E1 and E2), the healthy and Ca HV-infected individuals were intraperitoneally injected with CXCR4 antagonist AMD3100 (MedChemExpress, New Jersey, USA) (100 μg in 200 μl PBS).
statement: 在两个实验组中，健康个体和感染CaHV的个体被腹内注射CXCR4拮抗剂AMD3100（100微克溶于200微升PBS）。
text_zh: 在两个实验组中，健康个体和感染CaHV的个体被腹内注射CXCR4拮抗剂AMD3100（100微克溶于200微升PBS）。
text_en: In two experimental groups, healthy individuals and CaHV-infected individuals were intraperitoneally injected with the CXCR4 antagonist AMD3100 (100 micrograms dissolved in 200 microliters of PBS).

quote: Briefly, PBS or AMD3100 was injected per day until the fish died, and Ca HV was injected only once at the 24 h after the first injection of PBS or AMD3100 in PC and E2 group, while NC and E1 group injected PBS instead.
statement: 每天注射PBS或AMD3100直至鱼死亡；在PC和E2组中，首次注射后24小时仅注射一次CaHV，而NC和E1组则注射PBS代替。
text_zh: 每天注射PBS或AMD3100直至鱼死亡；在PC和E2组中，首次注射后24小时仅注射一次CaHV，而NC和E1组则注射PBS代替。
text_en: Fish were injected daily with PBS or AMD3100 until death; in the PC and E2 groups, CaHV was injected once only 24 hours after the first injection, whereas the NC and E1 groups were injected with PBS instead.

quote: After Ca HV challenge, the individuals in four groups were monitored every 24 h to score mortality.
statement: 在CaHV攻击后，每24小时监测四个组的个体以记录死亡率。
text_zh: 在CaHV攻击后，每24小时监测四个组的个体以记录死亡率。
text_en: After CaHV challenge, individuals in the four groups were monitored every 24 hours to record mortality.

quote: Cxcr4-blocked individuals showed more severe bleeding and lower survival rate (Figures 4A,B), indicating more susceptibility to Ca HV infection than control individuals (injecting PBS).
statement: 阻断Cxcr4的个体表现出更严重的出血和更低的存活率，表明其对Ca HV感染比对照个体（注射PBS）更易感。
text_zh: 阻断Cxcr4的个体表现出更严重的出血和更低的存活率，表明其对Ca HV感染比对照个体（注射PBS）更易感。
text_en: Individuals with Cxcr4 blockade showed more severe hemorrhage and lower survival rates, indicating they were more susceptible to Ca HV infection than control individuals (injected with PBS).

quote: The death started at 3 dpi in Cxcr4-blocked group and all died at 5 dpi, while the first death of control group occurred at 4 dpi and about 7% survivors appeared healthy at 10 dpi (Figure 4B).
statement: Cxcr4阻断组的死亡从感染后第3天开始，并在第5天全部死亡；而对照组的首次死亡发生在第4天，且在感染后第10天约有7%的幸存者表现健康。
text_zh: Cxcr4阻断组的死亡从感染后第3天开始，并在第5天全部死亡；而对照组的首次死亡发生在第4天，且在感染后第10天约有7%的幸存者表现健康。
text_en: Deaths in the Cxcr4 blockade group began on day 3 post-infection, and all animals died by day 5; whereas the first death in the control group occurred on day 4, and about 7% of survivors appeared healthy at day 10 post-infection.

quote: Accordant with more severe symptoms, the Cxcr4-blocked fish had markedly stronger bands than the control individuals at 3 dpi (Figure 4C).
statement: 与更严重的症状一致，在感染后第3天，Cxcr4阻断的鱼比对照个体具有明显更强的条带（指示病毒复制水平更高）。
text_zh: 与更严重的症状一致，在感染后第3天，Cxcr4阻断的鱼比对照个体具有明显更强的条带（指示病毒复制水平更高）。
text_en: Consistent with more severe symptoms, on day 3 post-infection, fish with Cxcr4 blockade had significantly stronger bands (indicating higher levels of viral replication) than control individuals.

quote: Notably, the chaperone gene dnaja3b was correlated strongly with neuroactive metabolites (e.g., normetanephrine), potentially implicating carvacrol in stress response regulation.
statement: 伴侣蛋白基因dnaja3b与神经活性代谢物（如去甲变肾上腺素）强相关，这可能表明香芹酚参与应激反应调节。
text_zh: 伴侣蛋白基因dnaja3b与神经活性代谢物（如去甲变肾上腺素）强相关，这可能表明香芹酚参与应激反应调节。
text_en: The chaperone protein gene dnaja3b is strongly correlated with neuroactive metabolites (such as normetanephrine), which may indicate that carvacrol is involved in the regulation of stress responses.

quote: Our findings demonstrate that carvacrol modulates liver gene expression and metabolic profiles, primarily influencing amino acid and lipid metabolism pathways, autophagy, and stress responses.
statement: 研究结果表明香芹酚调节肝脏基因表达和代谢谱，主要影响氨基酸和脂质代谢途径、自噬以及应激反应。
text_zh: 研究结果表明香芹酚调节肝脏基因表达和代谢谱，主要影响氨基酸和脂质代谢途径、自噬以及应激反应。
text_en: The results indicate that carvacrol regulates liver gene expression and metabolic profiles, mainly affecting amino acid and lipid metabolism pathways, autophagy, and stress responses.

quote: AMD3100 treated gibel carp had more severe bleeding symptom.
statement: 经AMD3100处理的银鲫表现出更严重的出血症状。
text_zh: 经AMD3100处理的银鲫表现出更严重的出血症状。
text_en: Silver crucian carp treated with AMD3100 exhibited more severe hemorrhagic symptoms.

statement: Parameter kualitas air selama penelitian tercatat sebagai suhu 26–28°C, pH 7, amoniak 0–0,003 mg/l, dan oksigen terlarut 6 mg/l.

quote: Hasil pengamatan tingkah laku ikan maskoki yang tidak diinfestasi Argulus sp. menunjukkan gerakan tubuh yang normal dengan nafsu makan yang tetap.
statement: Ikan maskoki yang tidak diinfestasi Argulus sp. menunjukkan gerakan tubuh normal dan nafsu makan tetap.
text_en: Ikan maskoki yang tidak diinfestasi Argulus sp. menunjukkan gerakan tubuh normal dan nafsu makan tetap.

quote: Kondisi tubuh ikan maskoki tersebut sehat tanpa terdapat luka baik pada permukaan tubuh maupun sirip ikan
statement: Ikan maskoki tanpa infestasi Argulus sp. dalam kondisi sehat tanpa luka pada permukaan tubuh maupun sirip.
text_en: Ikan maskoki tanpa infestasi Argulus sp. dalam kondisi sehat tanpa luka pada permukaan tubuh maupun sirip.

quote: sedangkan yang diinfestasi Argulus sp. menunjukkan gerakan tubuh yang tidak normal seperti menggesek-gesekkan tubuh pada kaca akuarium, selain itu ikan sering berada di dasar perairan serta nafsu makannya juga menurun, juga terdapat beberapa ikan maskoki yang berada di air permukaan pada akhir pengamatan.
statement: Ikan maskoki yang diinfestasi Argulus sp. menunjukkan gerakan tidak normal (menggesek tubuh), sering berada di dasar atau permukaan air, dan nafsu makan menurun.
text_en: Ikan maskoki yang diinfestasi Argulus sp. menunjukkan gerakan tidak normal (menggesek tubuh), sering berada di dasar atau permukaan air, dan nafsu makan menurun.
outcome: tingkah laku stres dan nafsu makan

quote: Gejala klinis yang terjadi yaitu terjadi pendarahan pada sirip ekor, kondisi tubuh terdapat luka baik pada permukaan tubuh maupun sirip ikan.
statement: Infestasi Argulus sp. menyebabkan gejala klinis berupa pendarahan pada sirip ekor dan luka pada permukaan tubuh serta sirip ikan.
text_en: Infestasi Argulus sp. menyebabkan gejala klinis berupa pendarahan pada sirip ekor dan luka pada permukaan tubuh serta sirip ikan.

quote: Ektoparasit Argulus sp. menyerang ikan maskoki dengan menghisap darah, sehingga menyebabkan ikan stress, dan terjadi perubahan tingkah laku pada ikan maskoki tersebut.
statement: Argulus sp. menghisap darah ikan maskoki sehingga menyebabkan stres dan perubahan tingkah laku.
text_en: Argulus sp. menghisap darah ikan maskoki sehingga menyebabkan stres dan perubahan tingkah laku.

quote: Perubahan tingkah laku pada ikan antara lain berenang pasif dan selera makan menjadi turun.
statement: Perubahan tingkah laku akibat infestasi meliputi berenang pasif dan penurunan selera makan.
text_en: Perubahan tingkah laku akibat infestasi meliputi berenang pasif dan penurunan selera makan.

quote: Although carvacrol has been shown to exert pro-inflammatory and apoptotic effects on liver tissue of LPS induced inflammation in fish [ 26 ]
statement: 已有研究表明，香芹酚对脂多糖诱导的鱼类炎症肝脏组织具有促炎和凋亡作用。
text_zh: 已有研究表明，香芹酚对脂多糖诱导的鱼类炎症肝脏组织具有促炎和凋亡作用。
text_en: Existing studies have shown that carvacrol has pro-inflammatory and apoptotic effects on fish liver tissue with lipopolysaccharide-induced inflammation.

quote: Yet intensive farming practices in China increase its susceptibility to disease outbreaks such as bleeding disease caused by Aeromonas hydrophila , necessitating effective health management strategies.
statement: 中国集约化养殖实践增加了彭泽鲫对嗜水气单胞菌引起的出血病等疾病爆发的易感性。
text_zh: 中国集约化养殖实践增加了彭泽鲫对嗜水气单胞菌引起的出血病等疾病爆发的易感性。
text_en: Intensive farming practices in China have increased the susceptibility of Pengze crucian carp to disease outbreaks such as hemorrhagic septicemia caused by Aeromonas hydrophila.

quote: In our previous research, we have previously investigated the effects of different dietary inclusion levels (0, 200, 400, 600 mg/kg) of microencapsulated carvacrol on growth performance, intestinal barrier function (including microbial, physical, and immune barriers), and disease resistance in Pengze crucian carp
statement: 先前的研究调查了不同膳食添加水平（0、200、400、600 mg/kg）的微胶囊化香芹酚对彭泽鲫生长性能、肠道屏障功能（包括微生物、物理和免疫屏障）及抗病力的影响。
text_zh: 先前的研究调查了不同膳食添加水平（0、200、400、600 mg/kg）的微胶囊化香芹酚对彭泽鲫生长性能、肠道屏障功能（包括微生物、物理和免疫屏障）及抗病力的影响。
text_en: Previous studies investigated the effects of microencapsulated carvacrol at different dietary supplementation levels (0, 200, 400, 600 mg/kg) on the growth performance, intestinal barrier function (including microbial, physical, and immune barriers), and disease resistance of Pengze crucian carp.
outcome: 生长性能、肠道屏障功能、抗病力

quote: Yet this reduced antibiotic use has led to unintended consequences, including decreased animal productivity and increased mortality rates [ 11 ].
statement: 减少抗生素的使用导致了意想不到的后果，包括动物生产力下降和死亡率增加。
text_zh: 减少抗生素的使用导致了意想不到的后果，包括动物生产力下降和死亡率增加。

quote: Immunostimulants are designed with the goal of improving fish health and performance in aquaculture without causing harm [ 14 ].
statement: 免疫刺激剂的设计目标是在不造成伤害的情况下改善水产养殖中鱼类的健康和性能。
text_zh: 免疫刺激剂的设计目标是在不造成伤害的情况下改善水产养殖中鱼类的健康和性能。
text_en: The design goal of immunostimulants is to improve the health and performance of fish in aquaculture without causing harm.

quote: Studies demonstrate its multifaceted benefits in aquaculture, including antibacterial effects [ 15 , 16 ], growth promotion [ 17 ], and immune enhancement [ 18 , 19 ].
statement: 研究表明香芹酚在水产养殖中具有多方面的益处，包括抗菌作用、促进生长和增强免疫力。
text_zh: 研究表明香芹酚在水产养殖中具有多方面的益处，包括抗菌作用、促进生长和增强免疫力。
text_en: Studies show that carvacrol has multiple benefits in aquaculture, including antibacterial effects, growth promotion, and enhanced immunity.
outcome: 抗菌效果、生长性能与免疫功能
